    level="1"
    right="Item 15"

>
[Bargainer's Instrument](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2116)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 96 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 1,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="" /><row>1 hour (envision, interact)</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _bargainer's instrument_ is a musical implement. The most typical version is a violin made from maple and spruce, its body stained so deep a purple it appears almost black. When activated, the instrument casts a [_planar binding_](/Rituals.aspx?ID=17) ritual to conjure a willing extraplanar talent to compete with you in performance.

 The contest could be a musical battle, a dance-off, an oratorical debate—the two of you could even use entirely different types of performance. The loser of the bout is magically bound to perform a task of the winner's choice within 1 week. The contest consists of taking turns to [Perform](/Actions.aspx?ID=59), starting with your opponent. The [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) check's DC is the higher of the opponent's Perception DC or Will DC, though the two parties can mutually agree to use an impartial judge instead. The first to reach four successes wins, with each critical successes counting as two successes. If you play the _bargainer's instrument_ as part of your performance, it grants you a +2 item bonus to the Performance checks.

 After the contest, the conjured creature can choose to return to where it came from or remain where you conjured it. The loser must endeavor to complete the task by all reasonable means within 1 week. Failing to complete it is shameful but has no further consequences. The instrument loses its magic and remains a non-magical [virtuoso instrument](/Equipment.aspx?ID=37).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
name: Bargainer's Instrument

---

This large brass medallion hangs low on the torso. It's shaped in the form of an unblinking eye, with a ring of turquoise as the iris and an orb of jet serving as the pupil. The amulet grants you a +2 item bonus to Perception checks. When you invest the amulet, you either increase your Wisdom score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever is higher.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You cast [_true seeing_](/Spells.aspx?ID=344).

[Artificer Spectacles](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2134)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 102 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 15,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn eyeglasses

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These seemingly ordinary rectangular eyeglasses feature clear lenses framed in copper. When invested and worn, they rest perfectly on the bridge of the nose and can only be removed by the wearer. You gain a +3 item bonus to [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) checks and any skill check made to [Identify Magic](/Actions.aspx?ID=24). When you invest the spectacles, you either increase your Intelligence score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever is higher. You must select the skills and languages the first time you invest the item, and whenever you invest the same _artificer spectacles_, you get the same skills and languages you chose the first time.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You cast a 3rd-level [_mending_](/Spells.aspx?ID=189) spell on an item you touch.

</column>

[Avalanche Boots](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2135)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 102 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 15,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn boots

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

While the insides of these boots are comfortable, fur-lined leather, the outsides are a jumble of slate plates, giving the impression of a rockslide. You gain a +3 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks and a +2 circumstance bonus to [Force Open](/Actions.aspx?ID=34) and [Shove](/Actions.aspx?ID=38). When you invest the boots, you either increase your Strength score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever is higher.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You succeed or critically succeed with a Shove;  **Effect** If the Shove was a success, you push your opponent up to 10 feet instead of 5 feet. If the Shove was a critical success, you push your opponent up to 20 feet, and you can then choose to knock them [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31).

</column>

[Dragon Handwraps](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2138)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 103 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 80,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn gloves

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Fist](/Weapons.aspx?ID=356)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These silken handwraps feature intricate embroidery of a serpentine red dragon adorned with golden thread. The handwraps function as _+3 [major striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [greater flaming](/Equipment.aspx?ID=295) [handwraps of mighty blows](/Equipment.aspx?ID=441)_. You also gain a +4 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks made to [Grapple](/Actions.aspx?ID=35) or [Shove](/Actions.aspx?ID=38). When you invest the handwraps, you either increase your Strength score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever is higher.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You slap the bottom of your palms with hands splayed outward, casting a 7th-level [_burning hands_](/Spells.aspx?ID=30) spell (DC 41).

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You succeed or critically succeed with a Grapple;  **Effect** You gain a +2 status bonus to your Athletics DC against any checks made to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) your grapple until the end of your next turn.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 20"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Laurel of the Empath](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2139)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Fortune" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=76" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 103 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 70,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cap

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This silvery, woven ring of leaves sits on top of the head. While wearing it, when you roll Perception for initiative, you can roll twice and take the higher result. This is a fortune effect. Whenever you spend at least 1 minute talking with a living creature, you automatically become aware of its attitude toward you. When you invest the laurel, you either increase your Wisdom score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever is higher.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per minute; **Trigger** You're hit by an attack;  **Effect** You take half damage from the triggering attack.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You fail, but don't critically fail, a saving throw;  **Effect** You anticipate the danger and guard against it, often in unconventional or almost inconceivable ways. Treat the failed saving throw as a success.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> 10 minutes (envision) ([fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=76), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You spend 10 minutes talking with one living creature, conversing in inspirational, religious, or philosophical terms. You gain valuable insights into the personality of your target—their alignment, hopes, dreams, and fears. When the ritual is over, you gain a +4 item bonus to all Perception checks made concerning the target for one month. Also, the target gains inspirational insight, allowing the target to use one of the two reactions listed above once during the next 24 hours.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

Made of soft and subtle black leather, these gloves fit tightly but aren't uncomfortable and don't impede your sense of touch. As long as you're trained in [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) while wearing these gloves, you're always considered one skill rank higher than your actual rank. If you possess a Legendary skill rank in Thievery, you gain a +2 item bonus to Thievery checks instead. When you invest the gloves, you either increase your Dexterity score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever is higher.

These sturdy leather sandals feature straps that wrap up to the knees. Etched in the leather are intricate patterns of stags leaping through the forest. **Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per minute; **Trigger** You attempt a High Jump or Long Jump but you didn't Stride at least 10 feet;  **Effect** You can attempt the jump normally. It doesn't automatically fail.

[Shadowmist Cape](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2143)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 104 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 40,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cape

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This black cape flows more like a vaporous liquid than fabric. The cape grants you a +3 item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks. When you invest the cape, you either increase your Dexterity score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever is higher.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** A creature misses you with an attack;  **Effect** Attempt a Stealth check against the triggering creature's Perception DC. If you roll a success, you're [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=22) from that creature until the end of your next turn or until right after you use a [hostile action](/Rules.aspx?ID=300) against that creature. If you roll a critical success, you're hidden from that creature until the end of your next turn, even if you use hostile actions against that creature.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** With a twirl of the cape, you transform yourself into a puff of gray smoke. You cast [_gaseous form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=129) on yourself.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 20"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Whispering Staff](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2146)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Staff" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=151" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 105 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 70,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This gnarled wooden staff is carved with humanoid faces in various emotional states. When the staff is activated, the faces begin to whisper a variety of languages in sibilant tones, creating what seems to be nonsense to all but the staff's wielder or those they choose to affect. The staff functions as a [_major staff of divination_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=353). While using the staff, you gain a +3 item bonus to [Decipher Writing](/Actions.aspx?ID=22), [Identify Magic](/Actions.aspx?ID=24), and [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) checks, regardless of the skill. When you invest the staff, you either increase your Intelligence score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever is higher. You must select the skills and languages the first time you invest the item, and whenever you invest the same _whispering staff_, you get the same skills and languages you chose the first time.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision ([mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) **Frequency** once per round;   **Effect** Through the staff's strange whispering, you gain a glimpse into the mind and desires of one creature you can see within 30 feet. Until the end of your next turn, that creature is [flat-footed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=16) to you and takes a –2 circumstance penalty to saving throws against your spells.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact ([mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [misfortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=110)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You point the staff at one creature you can see within 30 feet of you, causing the whispers to howl in that creature's mind. The target must attempt a DC 43 Will save. If it fails, whenever the creature attempts an attack roll, skill check, or saving throw, it must roll twice and take the worse roll. This lasts until the start of your next turn.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision ([fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=76), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You twirl the staff in three consecutive circles and call for the whispers to speak up. For the next minute, you and all allies within a 30-foot emanation around you can hear your staff's whispers clearly and distinctly, gaining benefit from their advice and mental protection. Whenever you and your affected allies attempt to Recall Knowledge or attempt a saving throw against a [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106) effect, you roll twice and take the better result. This is a [fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=76) effect.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Price** 30 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** tattooed on the body

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Geometric precision and perfect angles signify that an artist with exemplary knowledge of [dwarven](/Ancestries.aspx?ID=1) tattooing traditions created this body art. Your family's ancestral stories, recited throughout the tattooing process, bind your blood even tighter to theirs. During your daily preparations, you manifest a visitation by an ancestor—possibly via a dream, a vision, or a magical trinket left by your bedroll. Roll 2d20 and record the highest result. Then roll 1d6 and note a type of saving throw: 1–2 Fortitude, 3–4 Reflex, and 5–6 Will.

 In addition, until the next visitation, you gain a +1 item bonus to one [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) skill related to the ancestor, as determined by the GM. Usually, the ancestor provides a kind of knowledge they believe you'll need. For dwarven ancestors, the Lore skill is usually Architecture Lore, Engineering Lore, Genealogy Lore, Labor Lore, Mining Lore, Warfare Lore, or Lore about a dwarven deity.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision ([fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=76)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You rolled a saving throw of the noted type;  **Effect** Replace the roll with the d20 roll from your ancestor's visitation.

>
[One Hundred Victories](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2214)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />
<trait label="Tattoo" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=262" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 121 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 60 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** tattooed on the body

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

One hundred cuts, healed into diamond-shaped scars, represent the ability to withstand the attacks of your enemies. [Orc](/Ancestries.aspx?ID=19) warriors covet these scar patterns and cluster them around what they consider to be their strongest assets—a pattern around the heart signifies a warrior with great endurance, while one along the arms indicates great upper body strength. 

You gain a +1 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) checks. If you have [Ferocity](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=16) (such as from the [Orc Ferocity](/Feats.aspx?ID=83) feat or a similar ability), the first time each day you use it, instead of remaining at 1 Hit Point, your Hit Points are set to an amount equal to your ancestry Hit Points, even if this amount is more than you had before using Ferocity.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

[Sun Sight](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2218)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Tattoo" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=262" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 122 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 850 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** tattooed on the body

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Placed under the eyes like rays of light, this tattoo burns away illusions with the unmerciful brilliance of the sun. You gain a +2 bonus to Perception checks that involve sight. If you're [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=7), you receive a new save at the start of each of your turns to end your dazzled condition.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action to Three Actions" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The tattoo casts a 4th-level [_scorching ray_](/Spells.aspx?ID=992), with the rays emitting from your eyes. The number of actions you spend Activating the tattoo determines _scorching ray's_ number of rays. The tattoo also attempts to dispel each [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=92) on a creature hit by a ray ([counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) level 5th, counteract modifier +19).

</column>

Crafters choose tattoos that represent their dedication and skill in their chosen field. You gain a +2 item bonus to [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) checks. Furthermore, when you roll a critical failure on a Crafting check to [Earn Income](/Actions.aspx?ID=23), treat it as a failure instead.

<traits>

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Rows of triangles symbolizing shark teeth protect you from danger and enable you to take fierce retaliation against those who try to harm you. Seafarers, especially those on the seas of Minata, wear these tattoos in patterns, with multiple rows of regular triangles. You gain a +1 item bonus to [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) checks to navigate bodies of water.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> command;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You would be hit by an attack against your AC;  **Effect** You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the attack, or a +2 circumstance bonus if the attacker is in water or has the [amphibious](/Traits.aspx?ID=207), [aquatic](/Traits.aspx?ID=168), or [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165) trait. Whether the attack hits or misses, you gain a +2 status bonus to damage with the next Strike you make against the attacker before the end of your next turn.

summary_markdown: Rows of triangles symbolizing shark teeth protect you from danger and enable you to take fierce retaliation against those who try to harm you. …
text: <title level="1" right="Item 2" pfs="Standard" > Triangular Teeth Source Treasure Vault pg. 122 1.1 Price 33 gp Usage tattooed on the body --- Rows of triangles symbolizing shark teeth protect you from danger and enable you to take fierce retaliation against those who try to harm you. Seafarers, especially those on the seas of Minata, wear these tattoos in patterns, with multiple rows of regular triangles. You gain a +1 item bonus to Survival checks to navigate bodies of water. Activate Reaction command; Frequency once per day; Trigger You would be hit by an attack against your AC; Effect You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the attack, or a +2 circumstance bonus if the attacker is in water or has the amphibious, aquatic, or water trait. Whether the attack hits or misses, you gain a +2 status bonus to damage with the next Strike you make against the attacker before the end of your next turn.

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 122 1.1 **Price** 60 gp **Usage** tattooed on the body --- The name of your beloved adorns this stylized image of a heart. An _unbreakable heart_ tattoo can be received only at the end of a successful [_heartbond_](/Rituals.aspx?ID=33) ritual, serving as your token. The other participant can have a token other than a tattoo if they wish. If you have more than one heartbond, each _unbreakable heart_ you have serves as a token for only one of them. The love exuding from you grants you a +1 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks. When you use _heartbond's_ activity to learn your beloved's present state, you can also grant them a small gift, choosing from the following options each time. Make your choice after learning their state.
  • Your beloved gains 5 temporary Hit Points that last for 10 minutes.
  • The tattoo casts [_guidance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=142) on your beloved.
  • The tattoo casts [_stabilize_](/Spells.aspx?ID=307) on your beloved.
  • The tattoo casts [_light_](/Spells.aspx?ID=171) on your beloved's token from heartbond.

These tattoos are created using designs and techniques from Varisian culture. Such tattoos often depict the Varisian rune for one of the seven schools of magic, but one might instead show a creature or celestial phenomenon associated with the school, depicted in traditional Varisian iconography. The tattoo allows you to understand and speak [Varisian](/Languages.aspx?ID=44). If you already know that language, you instead gain a +1 item bonus on [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks you make when speaking Varisian to someone who understands it.

 Each description lists the school of each Varisian emblem, and the tattoo has the trait of that school. The spell the tattoo can cast is from its school. As with the Thassilonian magic that was once so prevalent in Varisia, these tattoos lack a symbol of divination.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> The actions required to Activate the tattoo are the same as those needed to cast its spell;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The tattoo casts its spell.

</title>

<traits>

<trait label="Tattoo" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=262" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 123 <sup>1.1</sup>

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** tattooed on the body

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These curving, delicate designs resemble leaves, vines, or creepers, most often wrapped around a limb, ear, or throat, or curled around specific muscles. They help you blend in among plants. You gain a +1 item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks, which increases to +2 in forests.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" />  ;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** A creature would detect you by [Seeking](/Actions.aspx?ID=84); **Requirements** You're in a forest or similar natural area; **Effect** The tattoo casts [_tree shape_](/Spells.aspx?ID=342) on you before you can be noticed. The duration of this spell is 10 minutes.

 If you've already Activated the tattoo, you can supply a separate casting of _tree shape_ to recharge the tattoo instead of having the spell's normal effect. This allows you to Activate the tattoo again in the same day. You can do so multiple times each day, but only as many times as you continue to cast _tree shape_ to recharge the tattoo after each use.

markdown:
**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 136 1.1 **Price** 10,000 gp **Usage** held in 2 hands **Bulk** L --- This exquisite fiddle is perfectly carved and balanced to produce the purest sound while granting its player perfect balance and poise. It grants a +2 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks. If you're a master in Performance, while playing it you also gain a +1 status bonus to Reflex saves and a +1 item bonus to Dexterity-based skill checks. If you're legendary in Performance, the bonuses are +2. When you [Perform](/Actions.aspx?ID=59) with the fiddle, you can choose to create a harsh and discordant note. You critically fail the Performance check, shred the strings of the fiddle, and create an 8th-level [_sound burst_](/Spells.aspx?ID=292), with a 40-foot emanation around you instead of a 10-foot burst. The fiddle can't be played again until the strings are replaced at a cost of 200 gp. **Activate** Cast a Spell; **Effect** You expend a number of charges from this instrument to cast a spell from its list.
  • **Cantrips** [_dancing lights_](/Spells.aspx?ID=58), [_ghost sound_](/Spells.aspx?ID=132), [_message_](/Spells.aspx?ID=190)
  • **1st** [_command_](/Spells.aspx?ID=45)
  • **2nd** [_calm emotions_](/Spells.aspx?ID=31), [_faerie fire_](/Spells.aspx?ID=107)
  • **3rd** [_enthrall_](/Spells.aspx?ID=104)
  • **4th** [_glibness_](/Spells.aspx?ID=135)
  • **5th** [_sending_](/Spells.aspx?ID=272)
  • **6th** _calm emotions_, [_dominate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=87), [_vibrant pattern_](/Spells.aspx?ID=357)
  • **7th** _dominate_, [_prismatic spray_](/Spells.aspx?ID=233), [_true target_](/Spells.aspx?ID=346), _vibrant pattern_, [_visions of danger_](/Spells.aspx?ID=358)
**Craft Requirements** Supply one casting of all listed levels of all listed spells.
name: Fiddle of the Maestro

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 11"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Alchemist's Haversack](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2305)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Extradimensional" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=67" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 145 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 1,400 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn backpack

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

An _alchemist's haversack_ is a sturdy leather backpack with two compartments. The main section contains an extradimensional space equivalent to a [bag of holding type II](/Equipment.aspx?ID=249), perfect for carrying bulkier alchemist equipment. A secondary partition can hold 2 Bulk of items, 1 of which doesn't count against your Bulk limit. This second compartment can also be activated (see below).

 Two shoulder straps and a thick belt for the waist hold the haversack on the wearer securely. These straps have pouches and loops for keeping alchemical items handy. They also contain magically expanded [alchemist's tools](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2) that grant you a +2 item bonus to [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) checks to create alchemical items.

 Water and undesirable material can't seep into the haversack, which cleans itself once per hour. When you reach in any part of the haversack, the item you sought is the first one you find. Also, the haversack preserves mundane ingredients, food, and drink inside, so they stay fresh indefinitely. This feature doesn't prolong the duration of magic or alchemical items.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command;  **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You gain batches of infused reagents during your daily preparations; **Effect** You pull one additional batch of infused reagents from the satchel's secondary compartment. If you fail to use these reagents by the end of your next turn, they're lost.

**Craft Requirements** You are an [alchemist](/Classes.aspx?ID=1).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
name: Alchemist's Haversack

Two shoulder straps and a thick belt for the waist hold the haversack on the wearer securely. These straps have pouches and loops for keeping alchemical items handy. They also contain magically expanded alchemist's tools that grant you a +2 item bonus to Crafting checks to create alchemical items. Water and undesirable material can't seep into the haversack, which cleans itself once per hour. When you reach in any part of the haversack, the item you sought is the first one you find. Also, the haversack preserves mundane ingredients, food, and drink inside, so they stay fresh indefinitely. This feature doesn't prolong the duration of magic or alchemical items. Activate Single Action command; Frequency once per day; Requirements You gain batches of infused reagents during your daily preparations; Effect You pull one additional batch of infused reagents from the satchel's secondary compartment. If you fail to use these reagents by the end of your next turn, they're lost. Craft Requirements You are an alchemist.

A _vaultbreaker's harness_ has four pockets across the chest. The pockets contain a set of [infiltrator's thieves' tools](/Equipment.aspx?ID=58), infiltrator picks, a [levered crowbar](/Equipment.aspx?ID=18), and a [glass cutter](/Equipment.aspx?ID=870). [Broken](/Conditions.aspx?ID=2) or destroyed items similarly reappear, restored, in their proper pockets at sunset.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;     **Effect** You cinch the harness to prepare for mischief. You gain a +1 item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks and a +10-foot item bonus to your Speed for 1 minute.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Clockwork" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=331" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />

<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 146 <sup>1.1</sup>, [Pathfinder #161: Belly of the Black Whale](/Sources.aspx?ID=51) pg. 79

**Price** 20,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cloak

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Paper-thin interlocking cogs and gears make up the bronze _clockwork cloak_.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You're struck by a melee attack with a held weapon;  **Effect** The folds of the cloak attempt to divert the attack and catch the weapon in the cloak's gears. Make an [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) check to [Disarm](/Actions.aspx?ID=41) the attacking creature.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;     **Effect** You wrap the cloak around yourself and the winding gears decelerate your body, causing you to enter standby mode. While in standby mode you don't need to eat, drink, or sleep. You remain aware of your surroundings but take a –4 penalty to Perception checks. You can stay in standby mode indefinitely, although your body ages normally. You can leave standby mode as a free action. If you do so to initiate combat, you gain a +2 item bonus to your initiative roll.

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn eyepiece

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

_Clarity goggles_ feature faceted lenses that filter your surroundings from several slightly different angles at once, giving you a sharper picture of them. While wearing the goggles, you gain a +1 item bonus to visual Perception checks.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You focus on your environment and the creatures around you to see them as they really are. The GM rolls a [secret](/Traits.aspx?ID=142) [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) check using your Perception bonus against any [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=92) effect created by a 3rd-level or lower spell or a creature of 8th level or lower. You must be able to see the illusion, and it must be within 60 feet. If the check succeeds, you see through the illusion for 10 minutes.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 147 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 1,750 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn eyepiece

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Anything viewed through these thin spectacles looks crisp and clear, and the earpieces accentuate sounds around you. You gain a +2 item bonus to Perception checks.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** The spectacles key in on someone to show you their social cues in perfect clarity. Choose a creature you can see. You gain a +3 item bonus on Perception checks you make to use [Sense Motive](/Actions.aspx?ID=85) against that creature. This benefit lasts until you Activate the item again in this way.

 If you're an [investigator](/Classes.aspx?ID=13), you can use this activation as part of the action you take to [Devise a Stratagem](/Actions.aspx?ID=546) or [Pursue a Lead](/Actions.aspx?ID=544), and you can do the latter even though you can't see the creature. You must choose the same creature you chose for Devise a Stratagem or Pursue a Lead.

**Craft Requirements** You are an investigator.

</column>

With lenses set in a silver frame, _spectacles of piercing_ sight grant you a +3 item bonus to visual Perception checks.

>
[Accompaniment Cloak](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2318)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Focused" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=74" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Occult" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=120" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 147 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 1,300 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cloak

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This lush velvet capelet is embroidered with images of musicians playing a wide variety of instruments. The images animate when you make art, remaining embroidered, but smoothly unknitting and reknitting in time with your performance. The figures play music that perfectly accompanies your instrument, voice, or movements, granting you a +2 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can use only to cast a bard [composition](/Traits.aspx?ID=31) spell. If not used by the end of your turn, this Focus Point is lost.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You peel the musicians from the garment and fling them around you. The cloak casts a 4th-level [_phantom crowd_](/Spells.aspx?ID=968) spell (DC 28); each of the 10-foot squares must be adjacent to you. The crowd looks like the musicians on the garment and continues to accompany your Performance checks. You can Sustain this effect as described in the spell.

**Craft Requirements** You are a [bard](/Classes.aspx?ID=3).

</column>

</title>

<traits>

<trait label="Focused" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=74" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 148 <sup>1.1</sup>, [Pathfinder #171: Hurricane's Howl](/Sources.aspx?ID=101) pg. 75

**Price** 1,400 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _dragon rune bracelet_ is a gold bangle formed around the scale of a famous [dragon](/Traits.aspx?ID=50). The bracelet is etched with esoteric symbols or words in [Draconic](/Languages.aspx?ID=2) that indicate kinship with dragons. As many types of _dragon rune bracelet_ exist as there are types of dragons, though bracelets associated with [uncommon](/Traits.aspx?ID=159) or [rare](/Traits.aspx?ID=137) dragons have the same rarity as the dragon.

 While wearing a _dragon rune bracelet_, you gain a +2 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks while interacting with dragons of the same type as the bracelet's scale (such as [red dragons](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=168)  or [cloud dragons](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=176)). You also gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=68) effects from any kind of dragon.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can spend only to cast a [sorcerer](/Classes.aspx?ID=11) [draconic bloodline](/Bloodlines.aspx?ID=5) spell. If not used by the end of your turn, this Focus Point is lost.

**Craft Requirements** You are a sorcerer of a draconic bloodline.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 11"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Eidolon Cape](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2323)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Focused" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=74" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 148 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 1,400 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cloak

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Though it appears to be one elegant piece, an _eidolon cape_ consists of a mantle for your shoulders and a detachable cape. The cape is designed to resemble your [eidolon](Eidolons.aspx), either with a direct likeness or with features reminiscent of your eidolon. For instance, if your eidolon is a [dragon](/Traits.aspx?ID=50), the cape might depict a stylized dragon, or it might have a pattern of colorful scales with gold trim. An eidolon cape features the sigil you share with your eidolon prominently in its design. You gain a +2 item bonus to the skill that matches your eidolon's tradition: [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) for [arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) for [divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) for [occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120), or [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) for [primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134).

 When you [Manifest your Eidolon](/Actions.aspx?ID=757), the cape transforms into the eidolon, and when the eidolon unmanifests, it turns back into the cape. If the cape is attached to the mantle, it comes free immediately, and the eidolon appears adjacent to you as normal. If not, the eidolon appears in a space adjacent to the cape. With the cape detached, the mantle is still light Bulk, and the whole cloak remains invested. If the cape is out of range (beyond 100 feet, typically) or there's not enough open space for the eidolon to manifest, your attempt to Manifest your Eidolon fails.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can use only to cast a summoner link spell. If not used by the end of your turn, this Focus Point is lost.

**Craft Requirements** You are a [summoner](/Classes.aspx?ID=18).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

 When you [Manifest your Eidolon](/Actions.aspx?ID=757), the cape transforms into the eidolon, and when the eidolon unmanifests, it turns back into the cape. With the cape detached, the mantle is still light Bulk, and the whole cloak remains invested. If the cape is out of range (beyond 100 feet, typically) or there's not enough open space for the eidolon to manifest, your attempt to Manifest your Eidolon fails.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can use only to cast a summoner link spell. If not used by the end of your turn, this Focus Point is lost.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Enchantment" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=61" />
<trait label="Focused" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=74" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 148 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 1,200 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Dangling from a simple cord, a _hexing jar_ houses rich soil. When a [witch](/Classes.aspx?ID=16) who has invested the jar wears it overnight, a miniature thing grows from the soil. Your patron chooses the form, commonly including glowing mushrooms, venus flytraps, mandragora roots, or undead hands reaching up. The thing whispers secrets it learned from your patron, giving you a +2 item bonus to your patron skill.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can use only to cast a witch [hex](/Traits.aspx?ID=324) spell. If not used by the end of your turn, this Focus Point is lost.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You roll a critical success on an attack roll with a witch spell, or your target rolls a critical failure on its saving throw against a witch spell or hex you cast;  **Effect** The thing in the jar becomes more energetic—glowing, dancing, rapping on the glass, or some other action appropriate to its appearance. It encourages you until the start of your next turn, granting you and your familiar a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws and a +2 status bonus against [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106) effects.

**Craft Requirements** You are a witch.

</column>

>
[Mask of Uncanny Breath](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2326)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Focused" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=74" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />
<trait label="Occult" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=120" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 150 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 1,200 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn mask

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A thin wooden mask carved in the shape of a skull, monstrous face, or eerily featureless visage, a mask of uncanny breath fully covers your face. While wearing it, each breath you take feels cool and pure, perfectly flowing to feed your ki. When you breathe in, fragments of bizarre knowledge flow through you, granting you a +2 item bonus to [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) checks.

Elegant jewelry such as the _master magus ring_ adorns experienced [magi](/Classes.aspx?ID=17). **Price** 1,200 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn headwear

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Gemstones of many colors adorn the silver of a _mind's light circlet_. When you're charged with mental power, the jewels scintillate with light, with different gems resonating based on your emotions. If you have at least 1 Focus Point, the gems cast [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408) in a 10-foot radius. When you amp a spell, the light increases to [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) in a 20-foot radius (and dim light to the next 20 feet) until the start of your next turn.

 You gain a +2 item bonus to [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) checks. You also gain the following [amp](/Traits.aspx?ID=425), which you can apply to any of your psi cantrips that have a target or area, much like an amp gained from a feat.

 **Amp** You transfer some of the magical luminescence from the mind's light circlet to one of the creatures. Choose a creature targeted by the spell or in its area. Until the start of your next turn, that creature sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light to the next 20 feet) and can't be [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4). If the creature is [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=26), it's concealed while alight, rather than being [undetected](/Conditions.aspx?ID=39).

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can use only to use a psychic amp. If not used by the end of your turn, this Focus Point is lost.

**Craft Requirements** You are a [psychic](/Classes.aspx?ID=21).

Patterns themed to your curse cover your _oracular crown_. As your curse worsens, the appearance of the crown changes, introducing extreme angles, stronger colors, or other indications of the intensity of your curse. Similarly, it gets closer to its natural form when you reduce the effects of your curse. You gain a +2 item bonus to [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) checks.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can use only to cast an oracle revelation spell. If not used by the end of your turn, this Focus Point is lost.

This amount increases to 5d8 if your curse is at its moderate stage or 7d8 if it's at its major stage. If you have [negative healing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=42), this activation has the [negative](/Traits.aspx?ID=118) trait and not the healing and positive traits.

**Craft Requirements** You are an [oracle](/Classes.aspx?ID=14).

text: <title level="1" right="Item 6" pfs="Standard" > Crown of the Companion Source Treasure Vault pg. 151 1.1 , Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind pg. 75 Price 250 gp Usage worn headwear Bulk L --- Stories tell of a king who once loved his subjects so much he was willing to give his own life energy for them, using an object like the crown of the companion . Whether true or not, this majestic wooden crown bears elaborate carvings depicting that tale with images of a regal figure giving increasingly of themself to a throng of needy subjects. While wearing this crown, you gain a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks. Activate Two Actions envision, Interact; Frequency once per day; Effect You bow to an ally within 30 feet, creating a magical bond between the two of you as if you cast shield other targeting the ally. The link remains even if you move more than 30 feet away from them. At the end of the spell's duration, your ally recovers 4d8 Hit Points and you recover half of what they recover.

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 151 1.1 **Price** 220 gp **Usage** worn headwear **Bulk** L --- Made of materials scavenged from wild places, a _druid's crown_ can be rebuilt for a variety of benefits. The crown grants you a +1 item bonus to a skill, and can be activated to cast a spell, both depending on the material used to build the crown, as listed on the table below. If you invest and wear [_druid's vestments_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=434) along with the crown, the crown's item bonus increases by 1 and its spell's DC rises to 27. You can invest this item only if you're a [druid](/Classes.aspx?ID=6). When you do, as a 10-minute activity that has the [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104) trait, you can disassemble and rebuild the crown with different materials, changing its item bonus and spell accordingly. ##
**Material****Item Bonus****Spell**
Antlers[Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7)[_Enlarge_](/Spells.aspx?ID=102)
Flowers[Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6)[_Animal allies_](/Spells.aspx?ID=863)
Leaves[Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15)[_Tree shape_](/Spells.aspx?ID=342)
 **Activate** envision; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The crown casts its spell at 2nd level (DC 20). **Craft Requirements** You are a druid.
name: Druid's Crown

markdown:
**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 152 1.1 **Price** 160 gp **Usage** worn headwear **Bulk** L --- Repurposing and enchanting a helmet worn by a battlefield commander can create a _tactician's helm_, imparting knowledge of battlefield tactics that feeds off your minor victories. The helm grants you a +1 item bonus to [Warfare Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) checks. Also, a jewel adorns the brow of the helmet. This jewel becomes charged each time you hit a creature with an [Attack of Opportunity](/Actions.aspx?ID=8). A _tactician's helm_ can hold up to 2 charges, and its charges reset to 0 when you invest it. **Activate** command; **Frequency** once per hour; **Requirements** The helm's jewel is charged; **Effect** One charge in the helm's jewel expires, and you choose one of the following effects.
  • **Charge!** Stride twice.
  • **Move It!** You gain a +2 status bonus to Acrobatics and Athletics checks until the end of this turn.
  • **Protect!** If you're wielding a shield, Stride to a space adjacent to an ally, then Raise your Shield.
  • **Re-Arm!** Interact up to three times. Each of these actions must be used to do something on [Table 6–2: Changing Equipment](/Rules.aspx?ID=194).
name: Tactician's Helm

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Enchantment" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=61" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 153 <sup>1.1</sup>, [Pathfinder #145: Hellknight Hill](/Sources.aspx?ID=4) pg. 77

**Price** 80 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _hunter's arrowhead_ is meant to be worn as a charm, such as a pendant, or carried in a pocket or quiver. The arrowhead is etched with images sacred to the elven god [Ketephys](/Deities.aspx?ID=110). While you wear or carry the arrowhead, it infuses you with great skill at hunting, and you gain a +1 item bonus to [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) checks and attack rolls against any creature you've currently designated as your prey with [Hunt Prey](/Actions.aspx?ID=10). A _hunter's arrowhead_ is also a [religious symbol](/Equipment.aspx?ID=41) of Ketephys.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> command;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You would miss with an attack made with a [bow](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=3);  **Effect** You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your attack roll, possibly turning a miss into a hit.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
name: Hunter's Arrowhead

---

The opal set in the intricately carved ivory _spiritsight ring_ eventually becomes translucent and tickles your finger whenever an [incorporeal](/Traits.aspx?ID=222) creature is nearby. When in the presence of a nearby incorporeal creature, even if it's within a solid object, you eventually detect the creature, though you might not do so instantly, and you can't pinpoint the location. This acts as a [vague sense](/Rules.aspx?ID=413), like humans' sense of smell. An incorporeal creature trying to hide its presence from this sense attempts a [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) check against your Perception DC to hide from your vague sense, as normal for attempting to foil [special senses](/Rules.aspx?ID=414). You gain a +2 item bonus when using the [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=84) action to find [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=22) or [undetected](/Conditions.aspx?ID=39) incorporeal creatures within 30 feet of you.

A patchwork of [humanoid](/Traits.aspx?ID=91) flesh makes up a _skinsaw mask_, which is stitched together with black silk or wire. It is distinctive for its bulbous orange eye—crafted from a magical glass bauble—and wide row of teeth. When worn, the mask amplifies your ability to sense fear in other creatures. You know the value of the [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19) condition of any [observed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=27) creature, and you gain a +1 item bonus to Perception checks to [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=84) frightened creatures. Whenever you deal precision damage to a frightened creature, you deal 1 additional precision damage. If you aren't evil, you are [drained 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=10) while wearing a _skinsaw mask_.

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 180 1.1 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** L --- Carved from a scale of the [kaiju](/Traits.aspx?ID=383) Igroon, this jagged shield refracts light around it in a shimmering haze. A _scale of Igroon_ (Hardness 20, HP 160, BT 80) recovers 4 Hit Points at the start of its wielder's turn. When you [Raise a Shield](/Actions.aspx?ID=98), you can use the [Shield Block](/Feats.aspx?ID=839) reaction with the scale of Igroon to block an attack or effect that deals acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, or sonic damage as well as physical damage. **Activate** Interact; **Requirements** You're in an area of [bright](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) or [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408); **Effect** You angle the shield to refract light. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a +4 item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=62) and [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=63) and can do so while [observed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=27). This bonus ends if you Activate another ability or use the Shield Block reaction. **Activate** Interact; **Requirements** You're in an area of bright light; **Effect** You angle the shield at a target within 60 feet, reflecting light into its eyes. It must attempt a DC 42 Fortitude save. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected.
**Success** The target is [blinded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=1) until its next turn begins.
**Failure** The target is blinded for 1 minute.
**Critical Failure** The target is blinded for 2d4 hours. **Activate** Interact; **Trigger** You use Shield Block and prevent yourself from taking energy damage from a line, ray, or a direct attack, including a [_magic missile_](/Spells.aspx?ID=180) spell; **Effect** You reflect the energy along a trajectory you choose. The effect travels only up to its remaining range, using its original parameters if it strikes other targets. **Destruction** If a deity, kaiju, spawn of a deity, titan, or being of similar power stomps on a _scale of Igroon_ while in absolute darkness, the shield is destroyed permanently.

markdown:
**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 180 1.1 **Usage** held in 2 hands **Bulk** 2 **Base Weapon** [Glaive](/Weapons.aspx?ID=20) --- This _+4 [major striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [greater brilliant](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1043) [keen](/Equipment.aspx?ID=300) [glaive](/Weapons.aspx?ID=20)_ binds the souls of powerful creatures it slays. The soul can't be returned to life by any means while imprisoned within the glaive and can be freed only by a deed of great benevolence or selflessness. While using the glaive as a weapon, whenever you reduce a sapient creature of 18th level or higher to 0 Hit Points or roll a critical success with a Strike against such a target, the creature must attempt a DC 50 Fortitude save. **Critical Success** No additional effect.
**Success** The glaive siphons the creature's essence, rendering it [drained 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=10). If the creature dies from the Strike or while drained in this way, the creature's soul is bound in the glaive.
**Failure** As success, but the creature is drained 2.
**Critical Failure** As success, but the creature is drained 4. The glaive also has the following activations. **Activate** envision; **Trigger** You Strike with the _Whisperer of Souls_; **Effect** You choose whether the Strike deals lethal or [nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=188) damage. If the glaive has a reason for doing so, such as slaying a creature whose soul the glaive can absorb, it can defy your choice if you fail a DC 50 Will save. **Activate** envision; **Trigger** You attempt an [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) check to [Decipher Writing](/Actions.aspx?ID=22), [Identify Magic](/Actions.aspx?ID=24), [Learn a Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=25), or [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26); **Effect** You listen to eldritch secrets the weapon whispers, gaining a +4 item bonus to the triggering check. **Activate** command, envision, Interact; **Frequency** once per week; **Effect** Attempt an Occultism check as if you cast the [legend lore](/Rituals.aspx?ID=15) ritual about a subject. If you roll a success or critical success, you can repeat what the _Whisperer of Souls_ relates to you about the subject. On a critical failure, you and the glaive are drawn into a murmuring void of cold, where your mind is assaulted by strange visions for an entire week. At the end of this time, you reappear and must attempt a DC 50 Will save. **Success** When you return, you can retrain one of your skills into a [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) skill about evil creatures or places, as if you had spent 1 week retraining.
**Failure** As success, but you are [stupefied 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37) for 1 week.
**Critical Failure** As success, but your alignment moves one step toward evil and you must retrain one of your skills into a Lore about evil creatures or places. You become obsessed with increasing your forbidden knowledge, turning to wicked forces that offer such secrets and compromising your morals further if you must. **Destruction** If the _Whisperer of Souls_ is used to slay [Shelyn's](/Deities.aspx?ID=17) [herald](/Traits.aspx?ID=330), it disintegrates, bringing about great evil in its wake.

_Note from Nethys: This item is a constituent part of the [Ursine Avenger Hood](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=200) archetype using the [archetype artifact](/Rules.aspx?ID=1961) rules._

A gift passed from warrior to warrior, this cowl is made from a [cave bear's](/Monsters.aspx?ID=48) skull and fur. Once invested, the wearer gains a +1 item bonus to [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) checks to [Command an Animal](/Actions.aspx?ID=58), which increases to +2 if the animal is a [bear](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=13). **Destruction** Soak the _Ursine Avenger Hood_ in the blood of a [linnorm](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=69) that is at least 16th level and then burn it in a fire that uses only oak and chrysanthemum as fuel.

Devotees of non-evil faiths fear and loathe _corruption cassocks_, each of which is dedicated to an evil deity. When the garment chooses a target, such as when it senses a worshipper of a good or neutral deity, it alters its form to match another deity's iconography, appearing to be a [_cassock of devotion_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=420) for that deity. Once donned, the cassock tries to subtly sway its wearer to the worship of its deity. If the wearer begins to succumb, the _corruption cassock_ gradually reverts to its true appearance, replacing its false iconography as its wearer converts.

 A _corruption cassock_ functions as a _cassock of devotion_ for any wearer it chooses. Once you invest the cassock, it fuses to you. The cassock has the alignment trait of its deity (LE, NE, or CE), and while you remain loyal to another deity, you believe it grants you a +2 item bonus to Religion checks and a +1 item bonus to the divine skill of the deity to whom you believe the cassock is dedicated. It does neither. The GM secretly adjusts your checks with those skills, causing you to fail at religious tasks more often. If you have multiple equal or lower item bonuses to the affected skills, the cassock takes precedence, negating those bonuses. If you convert to following the cassock's true evil deity, however, these bonuses function normally for you.

 If you attempt to Cast a Spell with an alignment trait that doesn't match the cassock's, it can force you to attempt a DC 28 Will save. On a failure, you're stupefied 1 for one minute (stupefied 2 on a critical failure). A _corruption cassock_ uses this ability to convince you that your deity has forsaken you.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can spend only to cast a  cleric domain spell for a domain belonging to the deity you believe the cassock is dedicated to. If you don't spend this Focus Point by the end of this turn, it's lost. However, when you use this activation, the _corruption cassock_ can instead cast a domain spell of the same level from its deity. It does so only to confuse and dismay you, harming your faith.

[Unfathomable Stargazer](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2391)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Cursed" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=274" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 193 <sup>1.1</sup>

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

An _unfathomable stargazer_ is a handheld brass telescope etched with constellations, the patterns of which form bizarre, shifting runes. You can observe the night sky with an _unfathomable stargazer_, however, the constellations you glimpse through the telescope distort with expanding and contracting fields of darkness among them. You use [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) instead of Perception or [Astronomy Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) when observing the skies with this item, and gain a +2 item bonus on all checks to do so. Once you use it, it fuses to you, and you must succeed at a DC 35 Will save to use another device to observe the stars, including your naked eyes. The telescope imposes a –4 circumstance penalty to [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) checks to [Sense Direction](/Actions.aspx?ID=64) or navigate. If you critically fail this Survival check, you're subjected to [_warp mind_](/Spells.aspx?ID=369) (DC 34) as you glimpse something horrifying and alien amid the darkness.

</column>

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 196 1.1 **Usage** 2 hands **Bulk** 16 --- **Perception** +22; [precise](/Rules.aspx?ID=411) vision 30 feet, [imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412) hearing 30 feet **Communication** [telepathy](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=37) (any languages the possessing spirit knew in life) **Skills** [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +23, [Music Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +23, [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) +25, [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14) +21 **Int** +3, **Wis** +4, **Cha** +5 **Will** +22 --- When a skilled musician dies before reaching their full potential or accomplishing an important goal, their soul might refuse to move on to the [Boneyard](/Planes.aspx?ID=15). Rather than becoming [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160), the spirit possesses an instrument they played in life, turning it into an intelligent item and a [virtuoso instrument](/Equipment.aspx?ID=37). (Other _phantom instruments_ exist, but most are heavy.) A _phantom piano_ offers a bargain to any bard or other skilled musician who finds it: receive musical aid as you dedicate yourself to reaching the success the spirit felt they were denied in life. The piano refuses to play for those who reject this deal. If you accept, the piano asks only that you practice with it and perform for increasingly refined and august audiences, requiring a successful [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) check appropriate to your proficiency level. The piano sets no strict timeline, but at the GM's discretion, if you go too long without making progress, the piano can cease cooperating with you until it's satisfied with your dedication once again. item_bonus_note: Deception checks to Feint
markdown:
**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 204 1.1 **Usage** worn --- Blessed by [Nivi Rhombodazzle](/Deities.aspx?ID=44), this striking silver necklace is adorned with sparkling sapphires that draw the eye of any who see it. Over the years, this necklace has appeared in many paintings and illustrations, usually around the neck of a carefree and daring adventurer or a stylish rake gambling vast sums of coin. Finding this relic is always seen as a sign of great fortune to come, but when that luck runs out, the necklace is lost just as quickly. Wearing the relic, you quickly realize how distracting it can be, granting you a +1 item bonus on [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) checks made to [Feint](/Actions.aspx?ID=48) and on [Games Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) checks made to gamble or determine the outcome of a game of chance. ---
**Minor Gifts**: [beginner's luck](/Relics.aspx?ID=97), [whammy](/Relics.aspx?ID=99)
**Major Gifts**: [clean luck](/Relics.aspx?ID=100), [perception filter](/Relics.aspx?ID=52)
**Grand Gift**: [against all odds](/Relics.aspx?ID=102)

item_bonus_note: Perception checks to Sense Motive
markdown:
**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 205 1.1 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** L --- A famed detective once owned the long, curved _sleuth's pipe_, taking it with them on investigations, keeping it in hand or mouth while cogitating. The pipe might have passed down through generations. Or, when an owner dies without heirs, it could go up for auction, be given to family friends, or remain at the scene of a crime to be found later. The _sleuth's pipe_ has sapience that eventually awakens, allowing the relic to act as a helpful assistant in investigations. Even while this sapience sleeps within the pipe, it grants you a +1 item bonus to Perception checks to [Sense Motive](/Actions.aspx?ID=85), and if you're an [investigator](/Classes.aspx?ID=13), any checks you make to [Pursue a Lead](/Actions.aspx?ID=544). ---
**Minor Gifts**: [beginner's luck](/Relics.aspx?ID=97), [repository of knowledge](/Relics.aspx?ID=51)
**Major Gifts**: [intelligent relic](/Relics.aspx?ID=109) (N), [steal luck](/Relics.aspx?ID=101)
**Grand Gift**: [mental bastion](/Relics.aspx?ID=54)
name: Sleuth's Pipe

item_bonus_note: Recall Knowledge about historical subjects
markdown:
**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 205 1.1 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** L --- The origins of the _watch of lost ages_, a silver pocket watch, are enigmatic. Its construction matches no known culture, and its appearance shifts back and forth from battered and tarnished to shiny and new without cause or apparent reason. The watch exudes a sense of melancholy and loss, and anyone holding it is acutely aware of the impermanence of all things and the march of time, moving ever forward. This relic might show up in a mysterious ruin or spontaneously appear in a spellcaster's hand after they cast a time spell. The relic grants you a +1 item bonus to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) about historical subjects. ---
**Minor Gifts**: [fervor](/Relics.aspx?ID=93), [sands of the hourglass](/Relics.aspx?ID=104)
**Major Gifts**: [fervent spell](/Relics.aspx?ID=95), [temporal pulse](/Relics.aspx?ID=106)
**Grand Gift**: [time reversal](/Relics.aspx?ID=108)

Astrolabes can be used for navigation in unfamiliar or featureless locations. To use an astrolabe, the holder must be trained in [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16). Using fabrics and fashion accessories, you disguise your armor to look like everyday clothing. After applying this adjustment, you can attempt a [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) check to [Conceal an Object](/Actions.aspx?ID=61) to hide the nature of your armor. You gain a +1 item bonus to this check. <title

    right="Item 5+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Boots of Free Running](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2456)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Firebrands](/Sources.aspx?ID=196) pg. 84 <sup>2.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn shoes

**Bulk** 1
</row>

**Access** Second-mark members of the Firebrands have access to this item.

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These comfortable and practical boots slip on easily and fill you with boundless energy. The treads of these boots provide exceptional traction, with improved grip on surfaces you would traditionally have difficulty traversing. While wearing the boots, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) checks to [Balance](/Actions.aspx?ID=28) and to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks to [High Jump](/Actions.aspx?ID=36) and [Long Jump](/Actions.aspx?ID=37).

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The traction of your boots improves, allowing you to run along vertical surfaces for 1 minute. When you Stride, you can run up solid vertical surfaces, like walls, at your full Speed. You must start your movement on a horizontal surface. If you end a Stride off the ground, you must Stride along the surface again until you reach a horizontal surface or you begin to fall (though you can [Grab an Edge](/Actions.aspx?ID=95), if applicable). If you have means of walking on water, such as with [_water walk_](/Spells.aspx?ID=371) or similar abilities, you can also run along flimsy vertical surfaces, as well as vertical liquids such as a waterfall.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Abjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=2" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Firebrands](/Sources.aspx?ID=196) pg. 85 <sup>2.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn gloves

**Bulk** L
</row>

**Access** Second-mark members of the Firebrands have access to this item.

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These black leather gloves fit snuggly, running up the length of your arm to your elbow. Each glove has an angular fin running along the outside edge of your arms, which forms a narrow triangle when your hands meet in a diving position. While wearing the gloves, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks to [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=39).

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision;   **Trigger** You would take [damage from falling](/Rules.aspx?ID=402) into water;  **Effect** The gloves create a hydrodynamic barrier around you, dispersing the damage that would be done to you during a high dive. You take damage as if the fall were half the distance, to a minimum fall of 5 feet. You then Swim with the effects of a critical success for the check.

[Stone of Encouragement](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2467)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Firebrands](/Sources.aspx?ID=196) pg. 87 <sup>2.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

**Access** Second-mark members of the Firebrands have access to this item.

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This smooth, round, gray stone fits neatly into the palm of your hand and feels comfortable to hold regardless of the size or shape of your hand. While you're holding the stone, it telepathically speaks to you at regular intervals in generic words of encouragement, such as “You can do it!” and “Let's go!” The encouraging words manifest in the voice of your internal monologue or take on the characteristics of the voice of someone you trust. Despite the similarity, you're aware that the stone is telepathically projecting its voice and can differentiate between the stone's voice and your internal monologue or the voice of the person you trust.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You ask the stone for help with a task. It speaks a few motivating words related to the task at hand, which grants you a +1 item bonus to the first skill check you attempt within 1 minute. You become temporarily immune to the effects of all _stones of encouragement_, even ones other than the one you activated, for 1 day. You can still hear the encouraging words of different stones if you hold them, but they don't provide any benefits.

_The Big Sky_ represents widespread change or liberation. If you are at least 17th level, the targets also ignore greater difficult terrain.

May contain spoilers from Stolen Fate **Source** [Pathfinder #190: The Choosing](/Sources.aspx?ID=198) pg. 77, [Stolen Fate Player's Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=197) pg. 5 **Usage** carried --- _The Empty Throne_ represents great loss and wisdom from those who are now gone. As long as you have _The Empty Throne_ invested, it grants you a +2 item bonus to [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14) and [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) checks made to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) regarding individuals who are no longer alive (such as checks to learn about Taldor's historical founder, but not to learn about its current empress). This increases to a +3 item bonus if you are at least 17th level. **Activate** envision; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You overwhelm a target you can see within 60 feet with feelings of helplessness and loss. The creature must attempt a Will DC equal to your class DC. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected.
**Success** The target can't benefit from circumstance or status bonuses for 1 round.
**Failure** The target can't benefit from circumstance or status bonuses for 1 day, and the target's allies are unable to benefit from circumstance or status bonuses while within 15 feet of the target.
**Critical Failure** As failure, except the duration is 1 week.

---

_The Liar_ represents obsession or treacherous love. As long as you have _The Liar_ invested, it grants you a +2 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) checks to [Lie](/Actions.aspx?ID=47). This increases to a +3 item bonus if you're at least 17th level. If the implausibility of your lies prompts a circumstance penalty to your Deception checks or an increase to your Deception DC, reduce that penalty or increase by half.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You touch a weapon and instill faithlessness within it. The weapon gains the [backbiting curse](/Curses.aspx?ID=3). The curse lasts until you use this activation again. If you're at least 17th level, you can instead use this activation on a weapon within 30 feet. If the weapon is carried by a creature, it can resist the effect with a successful Will save against your class DC.

You can change the skill by investing the card again. This increases to a +3 item bonus if you are at least 17th level. **Activate** envision; **Frequency** once per hour; **Effect** You choose to lose one of your senses and gain another until you use this activation again.   • Your eyes are replaced by dark pits that see only death. You become blinded and gain [lifesense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=21), an [imprecise sense](/Rules.aspx?ID=412) out to 60 feet. Lifesense allows you to see the vital essence of living and [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) creatures, distinguishing between the positive energy animating living creatures and negative energy animating undead creatures, much as sight distinguishes colors.
  • Your ears close up then become covered with hairs that are sensitive to movement. You become [deafened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=8), but you can't be flanked.
  • Your mouth seals over with flesh. You lose the ability to speak, but you do not need to [breathe](/Rules.aspx?ID=468).

_The Rakshasa_ represents domination of others to support your own schemes. When you invest _The Rakshasa_, identify a single willing creature within 30 feet as your pledged follower. If you have the maximum pledged followers active and select a new one, a previous pledged follower of your choice is no longer your pledged follower. ---

_The Marriage_ symbolizes a union of body, mind, spirit, or any of the three. When _The Marriage_ is invested, you gain a +2 item bonus to attempts made to [Request](/Actions.aspx?ID=51). This increases to a +3 item bonus at 17th level.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** Choose one adjacent willing creature. By brushing _The Marriage_ against their body, you form a magical bond with that creature that persists until you activate _The Marriage_ again to form a bond with a different creature. While the bond persists, you and the other creature can communicate via [telepathy](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=37) to a distance of 120 feet. As long as you and the target are on the same plane of existence and are both alive, you each remain aware of the other's state—you know the other's direction from you, distance from you, and any conditions affecting them. If your bonded target becomes [blinded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=1), [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=5), [controlled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=6), [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=14), [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19), [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=35), or [stunned](/Conditions.aspx?ID=36), you can use a reaction to attempt to [counter](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) the condition affecting the target, which also ends the bond between you and the target. The modifier on this counter check is equal to your class DC – 10. If you fail to counter the condition, that condition also afflicts you, and the bond with the other still ends.

This pair of silver bangles is engraved with images of crowns. While wearing the bangles, you are filled with an overwhelming sense of assertiveness and a more commanding presence. You gain a +3 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) checks. When you invest the bangles, you either increase your Charisma score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever is higher.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, envision;  **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You cast a 3rd-level [_fear_](/Spells.aspx?ID=110) spell (DC 38).

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** An enemy within 60 feet becomes [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19);  **Effect** You become emboldened by your enemy's fear.
