<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn bracers

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These brilliant golden bracers feature a hammer motif as part of their engravings. While wearing them, your body surges with strength and you gain a +3 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks and a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to [Disarm](/Actions.aspx?ID=41) and [Trip](/Actions.aspx?ID=40). If you succeed, but not critically succeed, at your check to Disarm a creature, the effects of your check last until the start of your next turn, instead until the start of the target's turn. If you succeed at a check to Trip a creature, it takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage or 4d6 bludgeoning damage on a critical success. When you invest the bracers, you either increase your Strength score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you a higher score.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You reach for a foe and attempt to topple them with a powerful flip. Attempt an Athletics check to Trip a creature within reach. On a success, the creature is knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31) and takes 10d6 bludgeoning damage (double on a critical hit). If you knock the creature prone, it must also attempt a DC 35 Reflex save. On a failure, it drops any items it's holding.

 When you invest the crown, you either increase your Wisdom score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you a higher score.

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

---

This simple, tattered cloak is a faded green and features small, stylized keys sewn throughout its length. While wearing the cloak, you fade into the shadows and gain a +3 item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks. When you invest the cloak, you either increase your Dexterity score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you a higher score.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;     **Effect** You brush your hand against the cloak and your fingers transform into picks, tension wrenches, skeleton keys, and any other tools, providing you with a full set of [thieves' tools](/Equipment.aspx?ID=58). This transformation doesn't otherwise hamper the normal use of your fingers or hands. These tools never break when you critically fail your check to [Pick a Lock](/Actions.aspx?ID=70). You can Activate the cloak again to revert your fingers to normal.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You place your hand against a wall, floor, or ceiling. You create a magical doorway within the surface that a creature can move through, as if the door had always been there. The doorway can penetrate up to 10 feet of material; particularly thick material, such as heavy stone walls, can cause this effect to fail, expending its use for the day. You can use an Interact action on the door to remove it from the surface and return it to its previous shape.

**Bulk** L

---

This elegant black sash features stylized crimson books embroidered at either end and a set of simple tassels. While wearing the sash, you feel as if you have a better understanding of the people and life around you. You gain a +3 item bonus to [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14) checks.

 When you invest the sash, you either increase your Intelligence score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you a higher score.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per minute;   **Effect** You focus on a creature you can see and attempt to gain an instinctual understanding of the creature. You attempt a check to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) about the creature, rolling twice and taking the higher result. If you roll a critical failure on this check, you get a failure instead. _The Betrayal_ represents selfishness and envy, twisting outcomes toward unfavorable or even devastating results. The object must be 2 Bulk or less. If that object is unattended, it teleports into your hand automatically. If the object is attended by a creature, you must make a Thievery check against the creature's Reflex DC. **Critical Success** The object teleports into your hand.
**Success** The object vanishes from the target's possession and lands on the ground at a point at a midway point between you two.
**Failure** The object does not vanish, but the creature's grip on it falters and if it doesn't spend an Interact action on its next turn to grip the item, it drops to the ground.
**Critical Failure** You fail to manipulate the object entirely.

text: <title level="1" right="Item 20" pfs="" > The Eclipse May contain spoilers from Stolen Fate Source Pathfinder #192: Worst of All Possible Worlds pg. 74 Usage carried --- The Eclipse represents self-doubt and loss of purpose, as well as a loss of faith. As long as The Eclipse is invested, you gain a +2 item bonus on Religion checks. This increases to a +3 bonus if you are at least 17th level. Activate Reaction envision (mental) Frequency once per day; Trigger A foe that you're aware of and who is within 60 feet achieves a critical success on a saving throw or a Strike; Effect You produce an aura of doubt that overwhelms all foes in a 30-foot emanation and reduces bright light in that area to dim light, as if the region were under an eclipse. The triggering creature's critical success is reduced to a regular success. All further saving throws or Strikes attempted by enemies within the emanation suffer a –2 item penalty; saving throws or Strikes attempted by the triggering enemy suffer a –3 penalty instead. You can sustain this aura of doubt for up to 1 minute.

---

_The Inquisitor_ represents the search for the truth and the power to see through lies. As long as you have _The Inquisitor_ invested, the results of your Perception Checks to [Sense Motive](/Actions.aspx?ID=85) against targets that are equal to or lower than your level are increased by one degree of success. Against targets that are higher level than you, you instead gain a +2 item bonus to your check. This bonus increases to +3 if you are at least 17th level.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact ([linguistic](/Traits.aspx?ID=101), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You swipe the card over the head of an adjacent creature to delve into their thoughts. You cast [_mind probe_](/Spells.aspx?ID=193), but as a two-action spell rather than one that takes 1 minute to cast. The level of the spell is one-half your level, rounded down (minimum 5th level), and the save DC is your class DC.

---

_The Trader_ represents trades and exchanges of information. As long as you have _The Trader_ invested, you gain a +2 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks made to [Gather Information](/Actions.aspx?ID=49). This increases to a +3 item bonus if you are at least 17th level.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** _The Trader_ allows you to make an exchange with yourself. Press the card to your brow, and then select two skills. Your proficiency rank with those two skills swaps for 1 hour. For example, if you were a master in [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) and untrained in [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4), you would become untrained in Athletics and a master in Crafting. If making this swap would break prerequisites to feats, you lose access to those feats until your skill proficiencies change back in an hour.

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

---

_The Unicorn_ represents finding what one seeks. As long as you have _The Unicorn_ invested, you gain a +2 item bonus on Perception checks to [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=84). This increases to a +3 item bonus if you're at least 17th level.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You pass _The Unicorn_ across an adjacent closed container and then open the container. Inside, you'll find a Common [consumable](/Traits.aspx?ID=36) alchemical or magic item you need to solve a problem or deal with a situation close at hand. For example, if you're badly wounded, you might find a [_greater healing potion_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=186). If you've been poisoned, you could discover a [_panacea_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=188). If you're faced with a written clue in a language you don't understand, the container might hold a [comprehension elixir](/Equipment.aspx?ID=88). The GM always decides what consumable item is discovered, and it must be equal to or lower than your level. If the consumable isn't used within 1 minute of being discovered, the item vanishes. If there's no appropriate item to solve your situation, the GM can rule that no object is found; in this case, the daily use of _The Unicorn_ is not expended.

</column>

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />

<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Highhelm](/Sources.aspx?ID=204) pg. 87

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn gloves

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Danila Kenn and Depa Stepwell of Common Goods developed these gloves after complaints from an exhausted grindlegrub rancher. Since their development, the gloves have become popular not just among grindlegrub ranchers, but laborers of all kinds in Stonebreach. The thick gloves are designed to help ranchers hold on to the squirming, slimy bodies of grindlegrubs, and help soothe the wear and tear of the day while restoring energy for after-hours pursuits. While wearing the gloves, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks. The gripping power of the gloves provides you with a +2 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves to [Grab an Edge](/Actions.aspx?ID=95). If you roll a success to Grab an Edge, you get a critical success instead, as the _gripping gloves_ allow you to hold on even with just a few fingertips.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You rub your hands together and take a deep breath to prepare for the rest of your day. You regain 3d8+10 Hit Points and feel refreshed, losing the [fatigued](/Conditions.aspx?ID=15) condition. As normal for effects that remove fatigue, this doesn't remove any underlying source of fatigue, such as lack of sleep, causing the condition to return if the underlying source isn't addressed.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Highhelm](/Sources.aspx?ID=204) pg. 87

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn gloves

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Danila Kenn and Depa Stepwell of Common Goods developed these gloves after complaints from an exhausted grindlegrub rancher. Since their development, the gloves have become popular not just among grindlegrub ranchers, but laborers of all kinds in Stonebreach. The thick gloves are designed to help ranchers hold on to the squirming, slimy bodies of grindlegrubs, and help soothe the wear and tear of the day while restoring energy for after-hours pursuits. While wearing the gloves, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks. The gripping power of the gloves provides you with a +2 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves to [Grab an Edge](/Actions.aspx?ID=95). If you roll a success to Grab an Edge, you get a critical success instead, as the _gripping gloves_ allow you to hold on even with just a few fingertips.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You rub your hands together and take a deep breath to prepare for the rest of your day. You regain 3d8+10 Hit Points and feel refreshed, losing the [fatigued](/Conditions.aspx?ID=15) condition. As normal for effects that remove fatigue, this doesn't remove any underlying source of fatigue, such as lack of sleep, causing the condition to return if the underlying source isn't addressed.

    level="1"

>
[Aerial Cloak](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2575)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Air" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=5" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 74 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Price** 60 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cloak

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This blue cloak is surprisingly light for its length and seems to catch wind bursts in its tail, flying out behind the wearer while cushioning falls and easing jumps. The sides of the cloak are slightly weighted, making it easy to grab ahold of when it fills with air. This cloak grants you a +1 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks to [Leap](/Actions.aspx?ID=81) and a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics checks to [Balance](/Actions.aspx?ID=28) or [Maneuver in Flight](/Actions.aspx?ID=30).

**Activate—Fall Gently** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You're [falling](/Rules.aspx?ID=401);  **Effect** The cloak catches the air and you grab onto its edges, utilizing the draft to guide you to safety. Treat your fall as 30 feet shorter and glide to a space of your choice at the bottom of your fall, which must be within 20 feet of where you would've landed.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
name: Aerial Cloak

[Jaathoom's Scarf](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2582)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Air" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=5" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 75 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Price** 900 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn belt

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This scarf is made of fine silk that's the same shade of blue as a clear, cloudless sky. The short ends are edged with a fine gold fringe that seems to sway even in still weather as though touched by invisible winds. The long edges have exquisite embroidery in threads that vary from a blue identical to the silk to the deep gray of storm clouds during winter. Wearing this scarf grants a +2 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks to dance and to [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) checks to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79).

**Activate—Vanish** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The scarf casts 4th-rank [_invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=164) on you.

**Activate—Jaathoom's Rebuke** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You let the winds around you catch the edges of the _jaathoom's scarf_, and a jaathoom shuyookh appears with a sudden updraft. The winds force your enemies back, granting you some breathing room in battle. Each enemy in a 10-foot emanation must succeed at a DC 27 Fortitude save or be [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 10 feet. A creature that critically fails is also knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31) after being moved. Creatures with the [air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5) trait are immune to all these effects.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

markdown:
**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 99 2.0 **Price** 1,800 gp **Usage** held in 1 hand --- _Jabali's dice_ are two six-sided dice carved from evenly weighted stone to the specifications of a specific jabali shuyookh. The sides showing a 6 also have the name and title of the shuyookh inscribed in Petran. If you whisper the name and title during a dice game using _jabali's dice_, they bless you with a bit of luck, granting a +2 item bonus to your [Games Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) check. You can do so frequently enough to apply this bonus while [Earning Income](/Actions.aspx?ID=23) using Games Lore, but only one user at a time can do so. **Activate—Jabali's Gamble** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You call out the shuyookh's name and title, then roll the dice. The shuyookh appears briefly to provide for your defense. Roll 2d6 to determine the effect. Represented by the GM, the shuyookh chooses any effect's specifications, benefiting you according to the shuyookh's whims.
2–5The shuyookh casts [_mountain resilience_](/Spells.aspx?ID=312) on you.
6–9The shuyookh casts [_grasping earth_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1334), but you and your allies are immune to it.
10–11The shuyookh casts [_wall of stone_](/Spells.aspx?ID=365). The edges can pass through creatures, which are shunted to the side of the wall opposite that edge.
12The shuyookh casts a DC 31 [_petrify_](/Spells.aspx?ID=123) spell on a creature hostile and in proximity to you. If no appealing target exists, you receive a 10–11 result instead.
name: Jabali's Dice

Represented by the GM, the shuyookh chooses any effect's specifications, benefiting you according to the shuyookh's whims. 2–5 The shuyookh casts mountain resilience on you. 6–9 The shuyookh casts grasping earth , but you and your allies are immune to it. 10–11 The shuyookh casts wall of stone . The edges can pass through creatures, which are shunted to the side of the wall opposite that edge. 12 The shuyookh casts a DC 31 petrify spell on a creature hostile and in proximity to you. If no appealing target exists, you receive a 10–11 result instead.

---

_Ash gowns_ are formal wear spun from smoke, ash, and char collected from the [Plane of Fire](/Planes.aspx?ID=6). Typically, they're voluminous floor-length dresses or three-piece suits, but regardless of their specific tailoring, _ash gowns_ are always an ostentatious display of wealth and loyalty to the powers of the Plane of Fire. They're exceptionally popular in the courts of the [Elemental Lords](/DeityCategories.aspx?ID=8) and among the high society of Medina Mudii'a. The gown grants you resistance 5 to fire and a +1 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) checks.

**Activate—Blazing Promenade** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The ash gown ignites in a ferocious blaze, flames licking the floor and trailing behind you like a dancing cape. You Stride and make a Strike at the end of your movement. During the Stride, your flames incinerate minor obstacles in your path; you ignore non-magical [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453), and any you move through is destroyed. Creatures that are adjacent to you at any point during your movement take 2d6 fire damage with a DC 23 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save. A creature doesn't need to attempt this save more than once, even if you move past it multiple times.

</title>

<traits>

<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 122 <sup>2.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The _brazier of harmony_ is a circular, orb-shaped censer etched with celebrating creatures shaking hands and dancing. The brazier contains a pleasant-smelling potpourri of dried flowers and incenses, designed to create a calm atmosphere that encourages meditation, thoughtfulness, and camaraderie. While holding the lit censer, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks, whether the censer is activated or not.

**Activate—Light Incense** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=206), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))**Cost** incense worth at least 1 sp; **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** When the incense is lit, pleasant, floral smoke surrounds the censer in a 20-foot emanation, creating a space of peace and harmony. Each creature that breathes the smoke is affected by 3rd-rank [_calm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=31) and is then temporarily immune for 24 hours. The spell's effects end when the incense burns out.

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 14"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Rhyton of the Radiant Ifrit](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2607)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 124 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Price** 4,200 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This exquisite, shimmering rhyton is made from volcanic glass and encrusted with rubies, garnets, and other red gemstones, with a blown glass sculpture of a snakelike fire elemental at its base. It was sculpted as part of a 10-piece set of drinking horns, created to match a powerful ifrit shuyookh's entertaining dinnerware, but it became separated from the rest of the collection. Whether for good or ill, the beautiful glass rhyton still carries tidings from its previous shuyookh owner, and you become their esteemed guest from afar whenever you hold it.

 The drinking horn functions as a [bottomless stein](/Equipment.aspx?ID=563), refilling with a common ale each time it's emptied. However, anyone holding the rhyton who whispers the name of its former shuyookh owner has the horn filled with their favorite wine, spirit, juice, or other beverage from anywhere across the many planes, as if their wish were granted by a magnanimous genie.

**Activate—Toast!** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** You raise a toast to a creature or creatures you're about to socialize with. You gain a +2 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5), [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6), or [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) checks against those creatures for 1 hour.

**Activate—Ifrit's Command** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** An ifrit's hospitality always comes with an implied threat. You cause the shuyookh to briefly appear and take its vengeance on those who would hurt you, the genie's “guest.” The shuyookh issues a 6th-rank [_command_](/Spells.aspx?ID=45) that targets all creatures [hostile](/Conditions.aspx?ID=23) to you in range instead of the usual number of targets. The shuyookh issues the same command to all of them. Each target that fails its save also feels all nourishment leached from it, becoming [fatigued](/Conditions.aspx?ID=15) as long as it's affected by the _command_.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
name: Rhyton of the Radiant Ifrit

    level="1"
    right="Item 3"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Smoke Veil](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2609)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 124 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Price** 60 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn headwear

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

_Smoke veils_ are wigs or headdresses made of flame and ash, giving the wearer a burning coil of fiery hair and concealing their face behind a smoldering, omnipresent haze of smoke and sparking embers. You can use the veil to go unrecognized by hiding your face so that you can attempt [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) checks to [Impersonate](/Actions.aspx?ID=46) without needing a [disguise kit](/Equipment.aspx?ID=19). When you do so, it takes you only 1 minute to create the disguise, and you gain a +1 item bonus to the check. You still need a disguise kit and the full time if you're using cosmetics and other props to change other aspects of your disguise, or if Impersonating a specific person.

**Activate—Blazing Stare** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32))   **Requirements** You dealt fire damage to a target you can see within 30 feet with your most recent action this turn; **Effect** You set your fiery gaze on your target, eyes burning within a cloud of ash and cinder. Roll an [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) check to [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=53) the target. Demoralize loses the [auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16) trait and gains the [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163) trait, and you don't take a penalty when you attempt to Demoralize a creature that doesn't understand your language.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 12"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Resonant Guitar](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2616)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Metal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=505" />
<trait label="Sonic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=147" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 146 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Price** 1,850 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Every part of this dark, shining guitar, from the strings to the soundboard, is constructed of metal. When the strings are strummed, the gilding on the guitar ripples like a liquid. A _resonant guitar_ is a [virtuoso handheld musical instrument](/Equipment.aspx?ID=37) that grants a +2 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks attempted while using it.

 A _resonant guitar_ is a planar key for [_interplanar teleport_](/Spells.aspx?ID=222) and similar magic to travel to the [Plane of Metal](/Planes.aspx?ID=24). When using it in this way, you can play a tune inspired by your destination to make it more likely to arrive where you intend to be, appearing 1d6×25 miles from your intended destination instead of 1d10×25 miles away.

**Activate—Strum of Thunder** <actions string="" /> 1 minute ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You play a magnetic tune, enchanting one metallic weapon within 60 feet of you. This item gains the [_thundering_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=306) rune for 1 hour.

**Activate—Chord of Protection** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** A creature within 30 feet of you targets you or an ally with a melee attack;  **Effect** You strike a piercing chord, putting up an invisible sound barrier between the target and the attacker. The target gains a +2 status bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the Strike still hits, the barrier breaks, dealing 3d10 sonic damage to the attacker.

</column>

>
[Conch of Otherworldly Seas](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2626)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=165" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 176 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Price** 1,850 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Magical writing covers the surface of this beautiful conch shell, which emits a blue light from inside. A _conch of otherworldly seas_ is a [virtuoso handheld musical instrument](/Equipment.aspx?ID=37) that grants a +2 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks attempted while using it. 

The conch is a planar key for [_interplanar teleport_](/Spells.aspx?ID=222) and similar magic to travel to the [Plane of Water](/Planes.aspx?ID=7). When using it this way, you can attune it to the waters of your destination to make it more likely to arrive where you intend to be, appearing 1d6×25 miles from your intended destination instead of 1d10×25 miles away.

**Activate—Voice of Oceans** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** You hold the horn to your ear and can understand and speak [Thalassic](/Languages.aspx?ID=113) as long as it remains there.

**Activate—Sounds of the Deep** <actions string="" /> 10 minutes ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** You hold the horn to your ear and touch the correct series of runes inscribed on its surface, causing the conch to cast a 5th-rank [_clairaudience_](/Spells.aspx?ID=39) spell for your benefit. Provided you choose a location that's underwater, you can extend the spell's range to 1 mile and hear with perfect clarity.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

---

Many of the experienced woodcarvers of the [Plane of Wood](/Planes.aspx?ID=25) learn to fight as well, the better to travel into hazardous areas in search of rare and beautiful types of wood for their craft. A _carver-cutter_ serves a dual role as a weapon and a tool for felling trees and engraving wood. The _+2 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [battle axe](/Weapons.aspx?ID=16)_ looks like an exquisitely made woodcutting axe.

**Activate—Carving Chisel** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** You pull free a woodworking chisel stored in the knob of the axe. It can have any standard chisel shape you imagine as you activate this ability. You get a +2 item bonus to [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) checks for woodworking if you use chisels from the _carver-cutter_. The chisel also functions as a [main-gauche](/Weapons.aspx?ID=32). All runes on the axe are replicated on the chisel, but only while both items are on the same person. You can Interact to reinsert the chisel.

**Activate—Chop Down** <actions string="Two Actions" /> (NULL);  **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** Make a Strike with the axe against a [plant](/Traits.aspx?ID=125) creature or a creature made primarily of wood. This Strike deals an additional 2d6 precision damage, and on a hit, the creature is [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=3) for 1 minute.

---

Many of the experienced woodcarvers of the [Plane of Wood](/Planes.aspx?ID=25) learn to fight as well, the better to travel into hazardous areas in search of rare and beautiful types of wood for their craft. A _carver-cutter_ serves a dual role as a weapon and a tool for felling trees and engraving wood. The _+2 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [battle axe](/Weapons.aspx?ID=16)_ looks like an exquisitely made woodcutting axe.

**Activate—Carving Chisel** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** You pull free a woodworking chisel stored in the knob of the axe. It can have any standard chisel shape you imagine as you activate this ability. You get a +2 item bonus to [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) checks for woodworking if you use chisels from the _carver-cutter_. The chisel also functions as a [main-gauche](/Weapons.aspx?ID=32). All runes on the axe are replicated on the chisel, but only while both items are on the same person. You can Interact to reinsert the chisel.

**Activate—Chop Down** <actions string="Two Actions" /> (NULL);  **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** Make a Strike with the axe against a [plant](/Traits.aspx?ID=125) creature or a creature made primarily of wood. This Strike deals an additional 2d6 precision damage, and on a hit, the creature is [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=3) for 1 minute.

[Tales in Timber](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2648)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Wood" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=508" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 202 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Price** 850 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn armor

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Armor** [Wooden Breastplate](/Armor.aspx?ID=36)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Dozens of pictorial stories—told in wood carvings, painting, or pyrography—adorn every outer surface of this _+1 [resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=279) [wooden breastplate](/Armor.aspx?ID=36)_. All are old, and many truly ancient, depicting tales set eons ago on the [Plane of Wood](/Planes.aspx?ID=25). You gain a +2 item bonus to [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) checks to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26). If you know the [_collective memories_](/Rituals.aspx?ID=15) ritual, you can use Nature instead of [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) if you're the primary caster.

**Activate—Statue Disguise** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The armor makes you look like a wooden statue version of one of the creatures depicted on the armor for 1 hour. This is a 3rd-rank [_illusory disguise_](/Spells.aspx?ID=159), but it can make you look like any creature depicted on the armor. This doesn't change your size or the capabilities of your body, and it scales the appearance of the creature to match yours. You can Dismiss the activation. This disguise is just real enough to make you somewhat closer to a creature of wood. You're affected by two spells while it lasts: [_oaken resilience_](/Spells.aspx?ID=20) and [_speak with plants_](/Spells.aspx?ID=294). If you stand still, you gain a +2 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) checks and DCs to appear as an inanimate wooden statue, in addition to the status bonus to Deception from _illusory disguise_.

Dozens of pictorial stories—told in wood carvings, painting, or pyrography—adorn every outer surface of this _+1 [resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=279) [wooden breastplate](/Armor.aspx?ID=36)_. All are old, and many truly ancient, depicting tales set eons ago on the [Plane of Wood](/Planes.aspx?ID=25). You gain a +2 item bonus to [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) checks to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26). If you know the [_collective memories_](/Rituals.aspx?ID=15) ritual, you can use Nature instead of [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) if you're the primary caster.

**Activate—Statue Disguise** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The armor makes you look like a wooden statue version of one of the creatures depicted on the armor for 1 hour. This is a 3rd-rank [_illusory disguise_](/Spells.aspx?ID=159), but it can make you look like any creature depicted on the armor. This doesn't change your size or the capabilities of your body, and it scales the appearance of the creature to match yours. You can Dismiss the activation. This disguise is just real enough to make you somewhat closer to a creature of wood. You're affected by two spells while it lasts: [_oaken resilience_](/Spells.aspx?ID=20) and [_speak with plants_](/Spells.aspx?ID=294). If you stand still, you gain a +2 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) checks and DCs to appear as an inanimate wooden statue, in addition to the status bonus to Deception from _illusory disguise_.

>
[Jann's Prism](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2655)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 224 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Price** 700 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Light always seems to be refracting through this simple prism, creating a hazy multicolor aura that surrounds the glass. When exposed to direct sunlight, the prism radiates a beam of light that shifts in color. This beam spells out the name of the jann shuyookh for whom the prism was designed. While holding the prism to your eye, your vision becomes overwhelmed with colors that guide your eye, granting you a +2 item bonus to visual Perception checks. If you look through the prism while you Seek, you can scan or search an area twice as large as normal (a 60-foot cone, 30-foot burst, or 20-foot square) as the varying colors help you distinguish between your surroundings.

**Activate—Jann's Light** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You raise the prism above your head and call upon the jann shuyookh to come to your aid. The shuyookh's face becomes visible in a reflection in the prism and light shines out from the prism, surrounding you in a multitude of colors. For 1 minute, you shed [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) in a 20-foot emanation (and [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408) for the next 20 feet). The light coruscates with two colors chosen by the jann, and you gain resistance 5 to two damage types based on the colors chosen: **red** [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), **orange** [acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=3), **yellow** [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56), **green** [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), **blue** [sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147), **indigo** [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), or **violet** [force](/Traits.aspx?ID=75).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
name: Jann's Prism

May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts **Source** [Pathfinder #196: The Summer That Never Was](/Sources.aspx?ID=214) pg. 81 **Price** 100 gp **Usage** worn cloak **Bulk** L --- While [Yaezhing](/Deities.aspx?ID=184) is feared and seldom worshipped in the open, some regions of Tian Xia see him as a god of necessary evil and their only hope for justice. This garment is often worn by bounty hunters or priests of Yaezhing, yet non-worshippers of the god of harsh justice sometimes wear this item without fear of religious persecution. The red cape appears almost black while in the shadows, with a lighter red mandala pattern on it that resembles a shuriken. When you invest a _cape of justice_, you must designate a single creature as your offender. You must have met the creature before, or the creature should have a persona well known to the public (for instance, a bandit's epithet, if not their face as shown on a wanted poster). You gain a +1 item bonus to [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=53) this creature. If you don't designate a creature as your offender when you invest the _cape of justice_, or if 24 hours pass without you either slaying or capturing your offender, your thoughts become worried and distracted and you take a –1 item penalty to Perception checks for the next 24 hours. **Activate** command, Interact ([force](/Traits.aspx?ID=75)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** By using a free hand to grab the edge of your cape and give it a quick flourish, you cause a red, shuriken-shaped bolt of force to fire at a target within 60 feet that you can see. The shuriken hits automatically and deals 1d4+1 force damage, or 2d4+2 force damage if the target is your designated offender. If the target is within 30 feet, you can attempt to Demoralize the target as a free action after the shuriken strikes them. **Activate** command, Interact ([incapacitation](/Traits.aspx?ID=93)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You produce [manacles](/Equipment.aspx?ID=32) from the cape and then fling them at a Medium or Small bipedal target within 30 feet. The target must attempt a DC 18 Reflex save. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected, and the manacles vanish.
**Success** The manacles strike the target's legs but fail to latch properly. The target is [flat-footed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=16) until the start of your next turn, at which point the manacles vanish.
**Failure** The manacles lock on the target's legs, causing the target to take a –15-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 minute, or until it [Escapes](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) or is freed by someone using [Pick a Lock](/Actions.aspx?ID=70) (DC 18), after which the manacles vanish.
**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target is [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=24) for as long as the manacles remain in place.

>
[Hongrui's Gratitude](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2684)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #196: The Summer That Never Was](/Sources.aspx?ID=214) pg. 82

**Price** 60 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cloak

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Given as thanks for honoring the memories of three unfortunate travelers who met a tragic end in the Willowshore Hinterlands, this red-hooded cloak is decorated with an image of an elaborately dressed performer whose two companions hold a lantern and umbrella for her.

**Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> command, envision, Interact ([evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=100)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You don't have the umbrella activation of this cloak active; **Effect** With a wave of the cloak to the left, you cause the image of the lantern-holding companion on the cloak to vanish. A floating red lantern appears at your side and follows you at an arm's length while casting [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) in a 20-foot radius (and [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408) for the next 20 feet) like a [torch](/Equipment.aspx?ID=60). For 1 hour, while the light from this lantern is active, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks. You can Activate the cloak again to dismiss the torch.

**Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> command, envision, Interact ([abjuration](/Traits.aspx?ID=2)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You don't have the lantern activation of this cloak active; **Effect** With a wave of the cloak to the right, you cause the image of the umbrella-holding companion on the cloak to vanish. An indestructible red wax paper umbrella appears above you and follows you, shielding you from weather effects, such as rain or bright sunlight. For 1 hour, while this umbrella is active, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) checks. You can Activate the cloak again to dismiss the umbrella.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Price** 60 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** tattooed on the body

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The _spider lily tattoo_ marks you as a trusted member of Granny Hu's network. This crimson tattoo fades and becomes invisible within a day of being applied, reappearing only when you Activate it, when you gain the [doomed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=9) condition, or when you die. The higher the doomed value, the more vivid the color. If your tattoo is plainly visible, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) checks against all creatures that can see the tattoo, but you take a –1 item penalty to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks to [Make an Impression](/Actions.aspx?ID=50) on those who understand the actual meaning of the _spider lily tattoo_ (including all of Willowshore's citizens).

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32))   **Requirements** Your tattoo isn't currently visible; **Effect** You make the tattoo visible. You can use this activation again to make the tattoo not visible, unless you have the doomed condition.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** An [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) creature detects you for the first time;  **Effect** The _spider lily tattoo_ manipulates your life force to make you appear to be undead for a short time. Attempt a [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) check against the triggering undead creature's Perception DC. On a success, the triggering undead believes you're undead as well—a [mindless](/Traits.aspx?ID=108) undead is likely to ignore you, while a sapient undead might react with curiosity or confusion. You can continue attempting Deception checks each round as a single action to Sustain the effect for up to 1 minute.

</column>

</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #196: The Summer That Never Was](/Sources.aspx?ID=214) pg. 83

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** affixed to wall

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This fulu seeks to keep thieves, spies, and unwanted attention away from a room. A depiction of a lock appears in the center of this fulu, which is in turn surrounded by circles of broken keys. When applied to a wall inside a room, all creatures within the room gain an item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks against creatures outside the room.

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 231 <sup>2.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn armor

**Bulk** 4
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Armor** [Full Plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=50)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Rippling water motifs decorate this simple suit of _+1 [resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=279) [full plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=13)_. The plate has been altered for underwater use, so it's check penalty doesn't apply to Acrobatics or Athletics checks in water or similar liquids. While wearing the armor, you gain a +2 item bonus to Athletics checks to [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=39), and you can breathe underwater. 

**Activate—Ride the Waves** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** The ripples on the armor begin to undulate, matching the movement of any nearby water. The armor casts [_water walk_](/Spells.aspx?ID=371) on you. 

**Activate—Submerge** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104), [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127))
 **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You merge with the water for 10 minutes. While merged, you can't move, you can see through the water if it's clear enough, and you can hear what's going on outside of the water. Water typically can't take damage, but if the water you're merged in is subject to electricity damage or an ability or effect that destroys or dries water, you're expelled from the water and take 10d6 damage. [_Control water_](/Spells.aspx?ID=51) expels you without dealing damage.

</column>

<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

---

Etchings of powerful bears decorate these brass bracers. You gain a +3 item bonus to Athletics checks and a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to lift a heavy object, [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79), and [Force Open](/Actions.aspx?ID=34). When you invest the bracers, you either increase your Strength modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value. 

**Activate—Bear Hug** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** Attempt to [Grapple](/Actions.aspx?ID=35) a creature. If you succeed, you crush the creature in your grasp, dealing bludgeoning damage to it equal to your Strength modifier. If you critically succeeded, the damage is equal to double your Strength modifier and the creature [suffocates](/Rules.aspx?ID=2439) as long as it remains grabbed or restrained by you.

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This [healer's toolkit](/Equipment.aspx?ID=25) contains a seemingly endless supply of bandages, herbs, and healing items of impeccable quality, granting you a +2 item bonus to Medicine checks. If you use the _marvelous medicines_ when you [Treat a Poison](/Actions.aspx?ID=56) or [Treat a Disease](/Actions.aspx?ID=55), before you roll your check, the medicines attempt to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) the poison or disease you're treating, with a counteract rank of 5 and a counteract modifier of +21. This is a healing effect. The medicines can't be used to treat the same affliction for that patient again.

    level="1"
    right="Item 18"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Possibility Tome](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3029)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 276 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Price** 22,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hand

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

An array of semiprecious stones is set into the ornate silver and beaten copper cover of this thick and weighty tome. If you open the book before it's been activated, its vellum pages are blank and pristine, but once activated, words dance and swim onto the pages before your eyes. 

**Activate—Skim** <actions string="" /> 10 minutes ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** As you flip through the book, you think about a broad topic you want to know more about. Choose one skill: Arcana, Crafting, Medicine, Nature, Occultism, Religion, Society, or a single subcategory of Lore. The book's pages fill with information about that skill, though only you can see the information. While the pages are full, you can spend an Interact action perusing the book just before attempting a check to Recall Knowledge with the chosen skill. This grants you a +3 item bonus to the check, and if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead. The information within the book disappears after 24 hours or when the tome is activated again.  

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

If you open the book before it's been activated, its vellum pages are blank and pristine, but once activated, words dance and swim onto the pages before your eyes. Activate—Skim 10 minutes (concentrate, manipulate) Effect As you flip through the book, you think about a broad topic you want to know more about. Choose one skill: Arcana, Crafting, Medicine, Nature, Occultism, Religion, Society, or a single subcategory of Lore. The book's pages fill with information about that skill, though only you can see the information. While the pages are full, you can spend an Interact action perusing the book just before attempting a check to Recall Knowledge with the chosen skill. This grants you a +3 item bonus to the check, and if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead. The information within the book disappears after 24 hours or when the tome is activated again.

[Accolade Robe](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3054)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Arcane" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=534" />
<trait label="Focused" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=609" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 <sup>2.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn garment

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Although not all wizards have gone through formal training, it's become tradition to enchant robes representing the arduous training required and festoon them with honors one has earned. Typically, an _accolade robe_ is styled after a single wizard school, with appropriate colors and symbols. Wearing these robes grants a +2 item bonus to Arcana checks.

 The pockets of the robe tie to an extradimensional space that can hold 1 Bulk of items, none of which can have greater than light Bulk. The items must be related to spellcasting and academics—spellbooks, scrolls, wands, scholarly journals, and other academic supplies the GM allows. These items do not count against your Bulk limit. You can Interact to retrieve or stow items normally. 

**Activate—Review** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** You retrieve an item of your choice from the robe's storage, then Recall Knowledge. 

**Activate—Extra Credit** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can spend only to cast a school spell. If you don't spend this Focus Point by the end of this turn, it is lost.

**Craft Requirements** You are a wizard of the associated school.

item_bonus_note: Bonus corresponds to the tradition of the last spell you enhanced with this aeon stone.
markdown:
**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 2.0 **Usage** worn --- Over millennia, these mysterious, intricately cut gemstones have been hoarded by mystics and fanatics hoping to discover their secrets. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to construct the universe in primeval times.
When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an _aeon stone_ with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful Disarm action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are suppressed until you return it to orbit your head again.
There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into a special magical item called a [_wayfinder_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=470) Aeon Stone (Amplifying) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 2.0 **Price** 9,750 gp --- An _amplifying aeon stone_ must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +2 item bonus to Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion checks—whichever corresponds to the tradition of the last spell you enhanced with this aeon stone. **Activate—Amplify** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [spellshape](/Traits.aspx?ID=513)) **Effect** If your next action is to Cast a Spell, that spell's rank is 1 higher (maximum 10th rank) for the purposes of counteracting and being counteracted. Aeon Stone (Consumed) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 2.0 **Price** 9 gp --- A _consumed aeon stone_ is a dull lump that has lost its magical properties. It still rotates your head like any other aeon stone and can thus serve as a stylish, hand-free option for various spells that target an object. This _aeon stone_ has no resonant power. Aeon Stone (Delaying) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 2.0 **Price** 350 gp --- When you would die from the dying condition (typically at dying 4), this smooth pink stone automatically activates and reduces your dying value to 1 less than would normally kill you (typically to dying 3). The stone then permanently turns into a _consumed aeon stone_. You can benefit from this ability only once per day, even if you have multiple such stones.
The resonant power allows you to cast 1st-rank [_heal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=148) as a divine innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Envisioning) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 2.0 **Price** 425 gp --- This clear cube allows you to communicate with a limited form of telepathy to a range of 100 feet. The messages are transmitted as a simple image each round. These images are the quality of a hasty or childish sketch but can be roughly understood by creatures regardless of language. This provides no special ability to respond to your images.
The resonant power allows you to cast [_translate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1723) as an occult innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Peering) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 2.0 **Price** 9,500 gp --- This faintly colored prism catches and transforms light. If the _aeon stone_ is in an area of bright light, shades of purple light provide dim light in a 30-foot radius. In that radius, magical items and effects are tinged with purple, the depth of the color revealing their [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) rank.
The GM also secretly rolls a counteract check against any darkness or illusion effect the light touches. It has a counteract modifier of +25. If the light fails to counteract an effect, it won't try again for 24 hours.
Inside a _wayfinder_, the aeon stone cannot catch light. However, its resonant power lets you activate or deactivate the aeon stone's light emitting from the _wayfinder_ as an Interact action. Aeon Stone (Nourishing) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 2.0 **Price** 325 gp --- After you've invested and worn this transparent stone for a week continuously, you no longer need to eat or drink. This time resets if you remove the _aeon stone_ or it's invested by someone else. The resonant power allows you to cast [_air bubble_](/Spells.aspx?ID=5) as a primal innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Preserving) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 2.0 **Price** 150 gp --- This red crystalline star covers you in a faint aura when you are subject to lingering wounds. You gain resistance 3 to [persistent damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). At the end of any turn where the persistent damage can't overcome this resistance, end that condition.
The resonant power allows you to cast [_stabilize_](/Spells.aspx?ID=307) as a primal innate cantrip. Aeon Stone (Smoothing) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 2.0 **Price** 310 gp --- This spherical piece of silvery stone helps you ignore minor issues. You can ignore status penalties to skill checks from [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=3), [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13), [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19), [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34), and [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37) conditions as long as the value of that condition is 1. Its resonant power allows you to cast [_guidance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=142) as an occult innate cantrip. Aeon Stone (Sprouting) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 2.0 **Price** 220 gp --- Encouraging the natural growth of life, this green ovoid can often be found surrounded by new seedlings. Its resonant power allows you to cast [_tangle vine_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1713) as a primal innate cantrip. **Activate—Flow of Life** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [vitality](/Traits.aspx?ID=509)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You are healed by a vitality efect or took void damage; **Effect** You gain 8 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute.
name: Aeon Stone (Amplifying)

**Bulk** L

</row>

---

This platinum choker bears characters from a language's alphabet, and it gives knowledge of that language and the associated culture's customs. You gain a +1 item bonus to Society checks and the ability to understand, speak, and write the chosen language. Your excellent elocution reduces the DC of the flat check to perform an auditory action while deafened from 5 to 3.  

**Craft Requirements** You know the language or languages the choker grants.

[Clandestine Cloak](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3067)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 287 <sup>2.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cloak

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

</row>

</column>

---

This cloak flows, covering and concealing the wearer's body. The cloak allows you to cast [_figment_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1528) as an occult innate cantrip. Although naturally a dull gray, while invested the cloak picks up colors and patterns from its surroundings, granting a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks. 

**Activate—Draw Hood** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You draw the hood up and gain the effects of invisibility, with the spell's normal duration or until you pull the hood back down, whichever comes first. While you are invisible, your figment innate cantrip gains the subtle trait, concealing the observable effects of your spellcasting.

This rugged metal eyepiece etched with square patterns is designed to be worn over a single eye. markdown:
**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 288 2.0 **Usage** worn headwear --- An elegant accoutrement for a witch who has come into the higher echelons of power, a _crown of witchcraft_ typically looks like a garland of flowering twigs, a jeweled circlet, or a tall hat of fine fabric. You gain a +1 item bonus to Intimidation checks, and if you're a witch, you gain a +2 item bonus to your patron skill.
If you have a familiar, you can attach a small portion of the crown's material to your familiar, such as a strip of fabric from a hat tied around its tail or a sprig of natural material linked to its collar; the familiar doesn't need to invest the item itself. If you do this, your familiar gains the [tough pet](/Familiars.aspx?ID=37) ability as long as the crown is invested by you. **Activate—Defiant Hex** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** Gain 1 Focus Point, which you can spend only to cast a witch [hex](/Traits.aspx?ID=324) spell. If you don't spend this point by the end of this turn, it is lost. **Craft Requirements** You are a witch. Crown of Witchcraft **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 288 2.0 **Price** 1,000 gp Crown of Witchcraft (Greater) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 288 2.0 **Price** 21,000 gp --- The bonus to Intimidation checks is +2 and the bonus to your patron skill is +3.
name: Crown of Witchcraft

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 288 2.0 **Usage** worn shoes **Bulk** L --- These brightly colored, soft-soled boots motivate you to perform risky stunts and grant you the agility to succeed. The boots grant you a +2 item bonus to Acrobatics checks and a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to Tumble Through an enemy's space.
The boots can grip solid surfaces and help you avoid a fall, allowing you to use the Grab an Edge reaction even if your hands aren't free. You treat falls as 10 feet shorter or, if you have the Cat Fall feat, treat your proficiency rank in Acrobatics as one degree better to determine the benefits of that feat. If you have Cat Fall and are already legendary in Acrobatics, you can choose the speed of your fall, from 60 feet per round up to normal falling speed. Daredevil Boots **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 288 2.0, [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 609 4.0 **Price** 900 gp Daredevil Boots (Greater) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 288 2.0, [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 609 4.0 **Price** 14,000 gp --- The bonus to Acrobatics checks is +3, and the bonus to Tumble Through is +2. The boots can be activated. **Activate—Daredevil Impulse** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The boots cast [_unfettered movement_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1732) on you.

markdown:
**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 291 2.0 **Price** 19,000 gp **Usage** worn garment **Bulk** 2 --- This strange and intricate harness fits snugly to the torso. Once you invest the apparatus, numerous artificial limbs with various tools, clamps, and lenses whirl into action, following your mental commands effortlessly.
When using this apparatus, you gain a +3 item bonus to Crafting checks to [Craft](/Actions.aspx?ID=43), [Earn Income](/Actions.aspx?ID=23), and [Repair](/Actions.aspx?ID=42), and you reduce the minimum time required to Craft an item to 1 day. If you succeed at your Crafting check and spend more downtime to continue work on the item after the minimum number of days, each day you spend reduces the remaining raw material cost by an amount based on your level + 1 and your proficiency rank in Crafting; on a critical success, each day reduces the remaining raw material cost by an amount based on your level + 2 and your proficiency rank. If you are 20th level, on a critical success your progress is 50 gp, 100 gp, 200 gp, or 350 gp for trained, expert, master, or legendary proficiency, respectively. **Activate—Inexplicable Patch** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You command the apparatus to magically jury-rig an item you hold or that's within 5 feet of you. The item is repaired, as a 3rd-rank [_mending_](/Spells.aspx?ID=189) spell. This lasts for 10 minutes, after which the item returns to its previous state of disrepair unless you've Repaired it before then.
name: Inexplicable Apparatus

This wide leather belt grants you a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks and increases the amount you can easily carry. You can carry Bulk equal to 6 + your Strength modifier before becoming encumbered, and you can hold and carry a total Bulk up to 11 + your Strength modifier. 

**Activate—Assisted Lift** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** You lift an object of up to 8 Bulk as though it were weightless. This requires two hands, and if the object is locked or otherwise held in place, you can attempt to Force it Open using Athletics as part of this activation. The object still has its full weight and Bulk for all other purposes—you just ignore that weight. The effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

This silver signet ring changes to match the insignia of a leader or organization you serve (or your own face, if you serve no one else). It grants you a +2 item bonus to Diplomacy checks and lets you cast message as an arcane innate spell at will.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 6+"
    pfs=""
>
[Primeval Mistletoe](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3100)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 294 <sup>2.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This sprig of berry-festooned holly and mistletoe doesn't wilt or rot. It can be used as a primal locus, and it grants a +1 item bonus to Nature checks while you wear it. 

**Activate—Anoint** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per 10 minutes;   **Effect** You squeeze juice from one of the berries and smear it onto a weapon made primarily of wood to cast [_runic weapon_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1658) on it, or onto a creature to cast [_runic body_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1657) on it. 

**Activate—Bind** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You touch the sprig, then a tree to cast [_one with plant_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1618) upon yourself, turning into a vine on the touched tree.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 6"
pfs="Standard"
>
Primeval Mistletoe
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 294 <sup>2.0</sup>, [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 574 <sup>4.0</sup>

**Price** 230 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 14"
pfs="Standard"
>
Primeval Mistletoe (Greater)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 294 <sup>2.0</sup>, [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 574 <sup>4.0</sup>

**Price** 3,900 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The sprig grants a +2 item bonus to Nature checks, the spell from Anoint is heightened to 6th rank, and the sprig can be activated in one additional way:

**Activate—Cultivate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You plant the _greater primeval mistletoe_ into an area of natural earth or stone. Once planted, the plant immediately sprouts into an area of holly bushes that don't impede movement and that pulse with vitality energy, replicating the effects of a [_field of life_](/Spells.aspx?ID=114) spell. You can Sustain the activation up to 1 minute. When this magic ends, the holly bushes revert back into the original _greater primeval mistletoe_.
name: Primeval Mistletoe

text: <title level="1" right="Item 6+" pfs="" > Primeval Mistletoe Source GM Core pg. 294 2.0 Usage worn --- This sprig of berry-festooned holly and mistletoe doesn't wilt or rot. It can be used as a primal locus, and it grants a +1 item bonus to Nature checks while you wear it. Activate—Anoint Two Actions (manipulate) Frequency once per 10 minutes; Effect You squeeze juice from one of the berries and smear it onto a weapon made primarily of wood to cast runic weapon on it, or onto a creature to cast runic body on it. Activate—Bind Two Actions (manipulate) Frequency once per day; Effect You touch the sprig, then a tree to cast one with plant upon yourself, turning into a vine on the touched tree. <title level="2" right="Item 6" pfs="Standard" > Primeval Mistletoe Source GM Core pg. 294 2.0 , Core Rulebook pg. 574 4.0 Price 230 gp <title level="2" right="Item 14" pfs="Standard" > Primeval Mistletoe (Greater) Source GM Core pg. 294 2.0 , Core Rulebook pg. 574 4.0 Price 3,900 gp --- The sprig grants a +2 item bonus to Nature checks, the spell from Anoint is heightened to 6th rank, and the sprig can be activated in one additional way: Activate—Cultivate Two Actions (manipulate) Frequency once per day; Effect You plant the greater primeval mistletoe into an area of natural earth or stone. Once planted, the plant immediately sprouts into an area of holly bushes that don't impede movement and that pulse with vitality energy, replicating the effects of a field of life spell. You can Sustain the activation up to 1 minute. When this magic ends, the holly bushes revert back into the original greater primeval mistletoe .

This plain silver ring has an almost oily sheen. While wearing the ring, you gain a +2 item bonus to Deception checks.

[Shining Symbol](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3109)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Divine" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=579" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Light" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=640" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 295 <sup>2.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

If you worship a deity, this golden amulet transforms into your deity's religious symbol when you invest it. You gain a +1 item bonus to Religion. The symbol casts dim light in a 20-foot emanation. 

**Activate—Spiritual Light** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=640), [revelation](/Traits.aspx?ID=686)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The light cast by the symbol becomes bright light for 10 minutes and shines through bodies to reveal hints of the spirits within. Creatures in the light receive a –1 status penalty to Deception and Stealth checks. You can Dismiss this activation.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 4+"
    pfs=""
>
[Symbol of Conflict](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3111)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Divine" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=579" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 296 <sup>2.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This tarnished necklace can be attuned only by someone who is holy or unholy. When you attune it, it transforms into your deity's religious symbol or a personal symbol if you don't have a deity. You receive a +1 item bonus to Religion and a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against holy and unholy effects. 

**Activate—Presence** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The symbol casts [_bane_](/Spells.aspx?ID=18) or [_bless_](/Spells.aspx?ID=25). The counteract DC of these effects is 18, and the counteract modifier is +8.

**Craft Requirements**  You must be holy or unholy.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

>

</title>

<traits>

</traits>

**Price** 900 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The bonus to Religion is +2. Change the list of spells to 4th- rank [_bane_](/Spells.aspx?ID=18), [_bless_](/Spells.aspx?ID=25), [_divine wrath_](/Spells.aspx?ID=86), and [_cleanse affliction_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1467). The DC is 27 and the counteract modifier is +17.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 18"
pfs="Standard"
>
Symbol of Conflict (Major)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 296 <sup>2.0</sup>

**Price** 19,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The bonus to Religion is +3. Change the list of spells to 6th- rank bane, bless, divine wrath, and cleanse affliction. Add 6th-rank [_summon celestial_](/Spells.aspx?ID=317) to this list if you are holy and 6th- rank [_summon fiend_](/Spells.aspx?ID=323) if you are unholy. The DC is 38 and the counteract modifier is +28.

This delicate necklace contains bottled whispers distilled from a source on the Astral Plane rumored to be connected to the first lie ever told. While wearing the necklace, you gain a +3 item bonus to Deception checks, and you can attempt to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) effects that would force you to tell the truth or determine whether you are lying. Success on this counteract attempt lets you ignore the effect, rather than removing the effect entirely. The counteract rank is 9, with a counteract modifier of +35. 

**Activate—Release the Lie** <actions string="Three Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** You unstopper the vial and release the lie, creating the effect of a [_fabricated truth_](/Spells.aspx?ID=106) (DC 47). The vial is emptied and can never be activated again.

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of _fabricated truth_.
